articles.title: Militer Israel mengklaim pekerja MSF tewas dalam serangan Gaza adalah anggota Hamas
articles.description: Militer Israel mengklaim para pekerja MSF yang tewas di Gaza adalah anggota Hamas dari pihak Israel yang mengatakan bahwa dua orang pekerja Dokter Tanpa Batas (MSF) -- Ahmed Sufyan Muhammad Ali Hasira dan Ma 'Aad Anda adalah anggota dari Ali Sabeh -- tewas dalam serangan udara di klinik di Gaza City adalah anggota Hamas. Dalam pernyataan, militer mengatakan Ali Sabeh adalah sebagai komandan unit artileri di Hamas apos; s sayap bersenjata, tanpa menyediakan bukti. Ini ditolak menargetkan rumah sakit atau merusak infrastruktur medis, mengatakan tindakan pencegahan telah dilakukan untuk meminimalkan korban sipil.
articles.originalTitle: Israeli military claims MSF workers killed in Gaza strike were Hamas members
articles.originalDescription: Israeli military claims MSF workers killed in Gaza strike were Hamas members The Israeli military has said the two Doctors Without Borders (MSF) workers -- Ahmed Sufyan Muhammad Ali Abu Hasira and Ma’ad Yousef Ali Sabeh -- killed in an air strike on a clinic in Gaza City were members of Hamas. In a statement, the military said Ali Sabeh was as an artillery unit commander in Hamas’s armed wing, without providing any evidence. It denied targeting a hospital or damaging medical infrastructure, saying precautions had been taken to minimise civilian casualties.

articles.title: Aliansi Mekah memenuhi tekanan kebutuhan untuk melanjutkan upaya bersama, Saudi menteri mengatakan
articles.description: Mekkah Aliansi memenuhi tekanan kebutuhan untuk melanjutkan upaya bersama, Saudi menteri mengatakan Arab Saudi, Turki dan Pakistan telah menekankan kebutuhan untuk upaya bersama berkelanjutan untuk mendukung "jalur politik dan pertahanan" dari Mekah Pertahanan Aliansi, Saudi Pertahanan Menteri Khalid bin Salman mengatakan. Dalam sebuah pos di X, ia mengatakan pertemuan kedua Komite Strategi Politik dan Pertahanan dari Aliansi Pertahanan Mekkah "menegaskan posisi negara kita 'bersatu dan peran aktif dalam menangani situasi saat ini dan kerjasama dekat dan koordinasi diperlukan untuk memperkuat keamanan dan stabilitas." Di sela-sela pertemuan, Khalid bin Salman mengadakan pembicaraan dengan Menteri Pertahanan Nasional Turki, Yasar Guler. "Kami memuji hasil pertemuan dan menekankan pentingnya untuk terus memperkuat dan mengembangkan militer dan kerjasama pertahanan untuk melayani kepentingan bersama kita dan mencapai keamanan dan stabilitas", katanya. Pertemuan kedua Komite Strategi Politik dan Pertahanan dari Mekkah Pertahanan Aliansi menegaskan sebuah' posisi unified '. Departemen Pertahanan Saudi Pic
articles.originalTitle: Mecca Alliance meet stresses need for continuing joint efforts, Saudi minister says
articles.originalDescription: Mecca Alliance meet stresses need for continuing joint efforts, Saudi minister says Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have stressed the need for continuing joint efforts to support the "political and defence tracks" of the Mecca Defence Alliance, Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman said. In a post on X, he said the second meeting of the Political and Defence Strategic Committee of the Mecca Defence Alliance "affirms our countries’ unified position and active role in addressing the current situation and the close cooperation and coordination it requires to strengthen security and stability". On the sidelines of the meeting, Khalid bin Salman held talks with Turkey's Minister of National Defence, Yasar Guler. "We commended the meeting’s outcomes and stressed the importance of continuing to strengthen and develop military and defence cooperation to serve our shared interests and achieve security and stability," he said. The second meeting of the Political and Defense Strategic Committee of the Mecca Defense Alliance affirmed a 'unified position'. (Pic Saudi Defence Ministry)

articles.title: Drone yang menewaskan dua orang Italia di Kuwait adalah Iran-dibuat, kata menteri asing Italia
articles.description: Drone yang menewaskan dua orang Italia di Kuwait adalah Iran-dibuat, kata menteri asing Italia Drone yang digunakan dalam serangan terhadap Kuwait yang menewaskan dua orang Italia diproduksi di Iran, Menteri Luar Negeri Italia Antonio Tajan mengatakan pada hari Jumat. Dalam sebuah wawancara dengan pers Italia, Tajan berkata: "Menurut penyelidikan yang dilakukan oleh orang Kuwait, pesawat tak berawak itu diproduksi di Iran". Serangan pada hari Kamis juga melukai dua orang lainnya. Hal ini menarik kutukan dari banyak negara, dan beberapa, termasuk Suriah dan Arab Saudi, menyalahkan Iran untuk itu. Sementara itu, Iran menolak meluncurkan pesawat tak berawak itu, dengan Menteri Luar Negeri Iran Abbas Araghchi menyebut insiden itu "mencurigakan". "Orang Iran mengatakan itu tidak diluncurkan dari wilayah Iran, tapi, seperti yang Anda tahu, proksi Iran, semua sekutu Iran, memiliki robot buatan Iran", menurut Tajan pers. "Akan ada penyelidikan, dan Iran telah mengatakan mereka siap untuk berpartisipasi dalam komisi penyelidikan bersama Italia dan Kuwait", tambahnya. Menteri Luar Negeri Italia Antonio Tajan: menurut penyelidikan yang dilakukan oleh Kuwait, pesawat tak berawak itu diproduksi di Iran. articles.originalTitle: Drone that killed two Italians in Kuwait was Iranian-made, says Italy's foreign minister
articles.originalDescription: Drone that killed two Italians in Kuwait was Iranian-made, says Italy's foreign minister The drone used in the attack on Kuwait that killed two Italians was manufactured in Iran , Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said on Friday. In an interview with the Italian press, Tajani said: "According to the investigations carried out by the Kuwaitis, the drone was manufactured in Iran." The attack on Thursday also injured two other people. It drew condemnation from many countries, and some, including Syria and Saudi Arabia , blamed Iran for it. Meanwhile, Iran has denied launching the drone, with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi calling the incident "suspicious". "The Iranians say it was not launched from Iranian territory, but, as you know, Iran's proxies, all of Iran's allies, have Iranian-made drones," Tajani told press. "There will be investigations, and the Iranians have said they are ready to participate in a commission of inquiry alongside the Italians and Kuwaitis," he added. articles.title: Dokter Tanpa Batas mengatakan dua staf tewas di 'hit langsung' Israel di klinik Gaza
articles.description: Doctors Without Borders mengatakan dua staf tewas di klinik langsung Israel Dua karyawan Dokter Tanpa Batas (MSF) tewas dalam serangan Israel pada salah satu klinik organisasi di Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat. Pemogokan itu "langsung hit" di klinik, organisasi mengatakan. "Kami hancur dan marah dengan pembunuhan dua rekan kami, kedua penjaga, dalam serangan Israel pada salah satu klinik Gaza kami malam ini", kata MSF di pos X "Tempat kami jelas ditandai dengan logo MSF, dan lokasi mereka telah dikomunikasikan dan dikenal oleh militer Israel", tambah. Organisasi mengatakan pembunuhan ini membawa jumlah staf MSF dibunuh oleh Israel di Gaza sampai 17. Serangan terhadap klinik MSF, dekat dengan Rumah Sakit Al- Shifa, membawa korban jiwa dari serangan Israel di seberang lapangan pada hari Jumat sampai delapan. Pada awal Jumat malam, orang Palestina lainnya ditembak mati oleh pasukan Israel di daerah Al- Mawasi, barat daya Rafah di Jalur Gaza Selatan, kantor berita Wafa dilaporkan. Kami hancur dan marah dengan pembunuhan dua rekan kami, kedua penjaga, dalam serangan Israel pada salah satu klinik Gaza kami malam ini. Ini adalah hit langsung di MSF, membawa total rekan MSF tewas di Gaza sampai 17. Tempat kami jelas ditandai dengan logo MSF, dan lokasi mereka telah dikomunikasikan dan dikenal oleh militer Israel. Kami berdiri dalam solidaritas dengan keluarga dan orang-orang yang dicintai rekan-rekan kami. Kami meminta pertanggungjawaban. - MSF International (@ MSF) November 27, 2026
articles.originalTitle: Doctors Without Borders says two staff killed in Israeli 'direct hit' on Gaza clinic
articles.originalDescription: Doctors Without Borders says two staff killed in Israeli 'direct hit' on Gaza clinic Two employees of Doctors Without Borders (MSF) were killed in an Israeli strike on one of the organisation's clinics in the Gaza Strip on Friday. The strike was a "direct hit" on the clinic, the organisation said. "We are devastated and outraged by the killing of two of our colleagues, both watchmen, in an Israeli strike on one of our Gaza clinics tonight," MSF said in a post on X. "Our premises were clearly marked with MSF logos, and their location had been communicated to and was known by the Israeli military," it added. The organisation says these killings bring the number of MSF staff killed by Israel in Gaza to 17. The attack on the MSF clinic, close to al-Shifa Hospital, brought the death toll from Israeli attacks across the strip on Friday to eight. Earlier on Friday evening, another Palestinian was shot dead by Israeli forces in the al-Mawasi area, southwest of Rafah in the southern Gaza Strip, Wafa news agency reported. 🔴 BREAKING - We are devastated and outraged by the killing of two of our colleagues, both watchmen, in an Israeli strike on one of our Gaza clinics tonight. This is a direct hit on MSF, bringing the total number of MSF colleagues killed in Gaza to 17. Our premises were clearly marked with MSF logos, and their location had been communicated to and was known by the Israeli military. We stand in solidarity with the families and loved ones of our colleagues. We call for accountability. — MSF International (@MSF) November 27, 2026

articles.title: Beberapa orang Palestina dipukuli dan ditahan dalam penggerebekan Israel di West Bank
articles.description: Beberapa orang Palestina dipukuli dan ditahan dalam serangan Israel di sekitar Raid Bank Barat yang diduduki dan serangan oleh tentara Israel dan pemukim di seluruh Tepi Barat pada hari Jumat kiri setidaknya tiga Palestina terluka dan beberapa ditahan. Tiga orang Palestina terluka dan lainnya, diidentifikasi sebagai Muhammad Daifallah Arara, ditahan pada Jumat malam setelah pasukan Israel menyerbu rumahnya di utara dari menduduki Yerusalem dan menyerang orang-orang di dalam. Ketiga orang itu menderita luka-luka pada bahu mereka, anggota badan dan anggota badan mereka setelah dipukuli oleh tentara Israel, sesuai dengan perintah pemerintah Yerusalem. Sebelumnya, sekelompok pemukim Israel menyerang rumah keluarga, mencoba untuk mendobrak pintu masuk dan badai halamannya, sebelum pasukan Israel campur tangan dan menyerbu rumah. Pasukan Israel menyerbu sebuah gua perumahan di desa Khirbet Khallat al- Daba 'a di Masafe Yatta, selatan Hebron, pada Jumat malam, menyerang pemiliknya, menahan anggota keluarganya dan merusak properti di dalam, Kantor Berita Wafa melaporkan. Gua itu milik aktivis Jaber Al- Dababseh, yang dipukuli oleh tentara Israel saat keluarganya ditahan. Pada Jumat malam, pasukan Israel menembakkan gas air mata ke warga Palestina di kota Beit Ummar, utara Hebron, selama serangan. Tentara Israel memaksa pemilik toko untuk menutup toko mereka. Di desa Jayyus, sebelah timur Qalqilya, pasukan Israel ditahan tujuh Palestina setelah merampok rumah mereka dan merampok properti mereka. Penduduk Israel juga melanjutkan serangan mereka di seluruh Tepi Barat yang diduduki sepanjang hari. Mereka menyerang kendaraan Palestina di Wadi daerah Shaer di pemerintahan Salfit, setidaknya merusak dua mobil, penduduk setempat memberitahu Wafa. Di kota Za' tara, timur Betlehem, pemukim mendirikan tenda, meningkatkan ketakutan antara penduduk Palestina bahwa mereka bisa membuka jalan untuk sebuah pos Israel baru di sana. articles.originalTitle: Several Palestinians beaten and detained in Israeli raids across occupied West Bank
articles.originalDescription: Several Palestinians beaten and detained in Israeli raids across occupied West Bank Raids and attacks by Israeli forces and settlers across the occupied West Bank on Friday left at least three Palestinians injured and several detained. Three Palestinians were injured and another, identified as Muhammad Daifallah Arara, was detained on Friday night after Israeli occupation forces raided his home north of occupied Jerusalem and assaulted those inside. The three sustained injuries to their shoulders, limbs and abdomens after being beaten by Israeli soldiers, according to the Jerusalem Governorate. Earlier, a group of Israeli settlers attacked the family's home, attempting to break down its entrance and storm its courtyard, before Israeli forces intervened and raided the house. Israeli forces raided a residential cave in the village of Khirbet Khallat al-Daba'a in Masafer Yatta, south of Hebron, on Friday evening, assaulting its owner, detaining his family members and vandalising property inside, Wafa news agency reported. The cave belongs to activist Jaber al-Dababseh, who was beaten by Israeli soldiers while his family members were detained. On Friday evening, Israeli forces fired tear gas at Palestinian residents in the town of Beit Ummar, north of Hebron, during a raid. Israeli soldiers forced shop owners to close their stores. In the village of Jayyus, east of Qalqilya, Israeli forces detained seven Palestinians after raiding their homes and ransacking their property. Israeli settlers also continued their attacks across the occupied West Bank throughout the day. They attacked Palestinian vehicles in the Wadi al-Shaer area in the Salfit governorate, damaging at least two, locals told Wafa. In the town of Za'tara, east of Bethlehem, settlers set up tents, raising fears among Palestinian residents that they could pave the way for a new Israeli outpost there. articles.description: Pasar saham Oman pada jalur untuk mengalahkan semua negara Teluk pada 2026 Disampaikan oleh Sean Mathews pada Fri, 11 / 27 / 2026 - 21: 00 Ekonomi Oman telah muncul sebagai pemenang relatif di tengah perang di Iran berkat geografi dan diplomasi, para ahli mengatakan Seorang pria melihat Rasool al Adham Masjid dari Corniche di Port Sultan Qabos di ibukota Oman, Muscat, pada 5 Februari 2026 (Loic Venance / AFP) dari pasar saham Oman akan menjadi pemain terbaik di daerah Teluk pada 2026, dengan pertumbuhan ekonomi yang menarik depan tetangga, dalam tanda-tanda bagaimana perang itu berasal dari Iran berasal dari perang tersebut. Indeks MSX30, yang melacak kinerja dari perdagangan saham Oman, telah melambung 22 persen tahun-tanggal. Pasar saham Dubai, Indeks Pasar Keuangan Dubai, pemain kedua terbaik di wilayah ini, meningkat 8.7% dari sekarang. Pasar Tadaul Arab Saudi menurun 3 persen tahun ke-date. Sebagai perbandingan, di AS, indeks SP500 naik 6,4 persen tahun -to-date setelah pelarangan tajam dalam AI dan teknologi. Pasar saham Saudi dan Dubai telah mencakar kembali kerugian curam awal tahun ini setelah AS dan Israel meluncurkan perang terhadap Iran. Namun kesuksesan Oman lebih menarik ketika orang menganggap kemarahan Presiden AS Donald Trump ditujukan pada hal itu selama negosiasi dengan Iran untuk mengelola lalu lintas di Selat Hormuz, yang terdiri dari perairan teritorial Iran dan Oman. Trump mengancam untuk "meledakkan" Oman, dimana bisnis real estate keluarganya telah melisensikan namanya untuk digunakan di sebuah resor golf. Dari luar hingga ketegangan pada trailblazer masih antara AS dan Iran. Amerika telah meluncurkan serangan ke Iran dan kapal-kapalnya, sementara Iran telah menyerang kapal-kapal di Selat Hormuz dan negara-negara Teluk. Kuwait menyalahkan Iran atas serangan pada hari Kamis yang menewaskan dua tentara Italia di sebuah situs militer. articles.originalTitle: Oman's stock market on track to beat all Gulf states in 2026
articles.originalDescription: Oman's stock market on track to beat all Gulf states in 2026 Submitted by Sean Mathews on Fri, 11/27/2026 - 21:00 Oman's economy has emerged as a relative winner amid the Iran war thanks to its geography and diplomacy, experts say A man views Rasool al-Adham Mosque from the corniche at Port Sultan Qaboos in Oman's capital, Muscat, on 5 February 2026 (Loic Venance/AFP) Off Oman’s stock market is on track to be the best performer in the Gulf region in 2026, with its economic growth pulling ahead of neighbours, in a sign of how it is reaping gains from distancing itself from the US-Israeli war on Iran. The MSX30 Index, which tracks the performance of Oman’s stock exchange, has soared 22 percent year-to-date. Dubai's stock market, the Dubai Financial Market General Index, the region’s second-best performer, is up 8.7 percent year-to-date. Saudi Arabia’s Tadawul market is down 3 percent year-to-date. For comparison, in the US, the SP500 index is up 6.4 percent year-to-date after a sharp selloff in AI and technology. Both the Saudi and Dubai stock markets have clawed back the steep losses of earlier this year after the US and Israel launched a war on Iran. But Oman's success is more interesting when one considers the anger US President Donald Trump directed at it during negotiations with Iran over the way to manage traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, which is comprised of Iran and Oman's territorial waters. Trump threatened to “blow up” Oman, where his family real estate business has licensed its name for use on a golf resort. Oman: From outlier to trailblazer Tensions are still simmering between the US and Iran. articles.title: Serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza membunuh empat orang Palestina
articles.description: Serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza membunuh empat orang Palestina, serangan Israel, menewaskan empat orang Palestina di Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat, agen berita Palestina, Wafa melaporkan. Beberapa lainnya, termasuk seorang anak, terluka dalam serangkaian serangan di seberang jalan. Di kota selatan Rafah, awak pertahanan sipil Gaza pulih tiga mayat. Mereka juga menyelamatkan dua orang yang terluka setelah serangan Israel dekat Masjid Muawiya di jalan Bahr, di barat kota. Wafa melaporkan pada hari Jumat bahwa pesawat tak berawak Israel menabrak kendaraan di daerah Bir di Naaja, sebelah barat kamp pengungsi Jabalia, membunuh orang Palestina dan melukai beberapa orang lainnya, beberapa serius. Sumber medis dan saksi mata mengatakan pasukan Israel ditempatkan di dekat begitu disebut "Yellow Line" berulang kali menembak pada tenda melindungi pengungsi Palestina di daerah tersebut. Yang disebut "Garis Kuning" adalah batas militer yang diberlakukan oleh pasukan Israel di Jalur Gaza setelah persetujuan gencatan senjata Oktober 2025. Sejak gencatan senjata terjadi pada Oktober 2025, lebih dari 1.600 warga Palestina dilaporkan tewas dan 5,833 terluka. articles.originalTitle: Israeli attacks across Gaza kill four Palestinians
articles.originalDescription: Israeli attacks across Gaza kill four Palestinians Israeli attacks killed four Palestinians across the Gaza Strip on Friday, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. Several others, including a child, were wounded in a series of attacks across the strip. In the southern city of Rafah, Gaza's civil defence crews recovered three bodies. They also rescued two wounded people after an Israeli strike near the Muawiya Mosque on al-Bahr Street, in the west of the city. Wafa reported earlier on Friday that an Israeli drone struck a vehicle in the Bir al-Naaja area, west of the Jabalia refugee camp, killing a Palestinian man and wounding several others, some seriously. Medical sources and eyewitnesses said Israeli forces stationed near the so-called "Yellow Line" repeatedly opened fire on tents sheltering displaced Palestinians in the area. The so-called "Yellow Line" is a military boundary imposed by Israeli forces inside the Gaza Strip following the October 2025 ceasefire agreement. Since the ceasefire came into effect in October 2025, more than 1,600 Palestinians have reportedly been killed and 5,833 injured. Mourners carry the shrouded bodies of Palestinians killed in an Israeli air strike the night before, at Al-Shifa hospital in Gaza City, 26 November 2026 (Omar Al-Qattaa/AFP)

articles.title: Hak-hak PBB suara keprihatinan sebagai Costa Rica bar Francesca Albanese
articles.description: Kepala hak-hak PBB keprihatinan sebagai bar Kosta Rika Francesca Albanese Costa Rica menolak masuk ke Francesca Albanese, raportir khusus PBB pada wilayah Palestina yang diduduki, menarik kritik dari Kepala HAM PBB Volker Turk pada hari Jumat. Turk mengatakan dia "sangat prihatin" oleh keputusan Kosta Rika untuk melarang orang Albania untuk memasuki negara dan mendesak pihak berwenang untuk mempertimbangkan kembali setelah dia dihentikan di bandara Juan Santamaria, yang melayani ibukota San Jose. Albania, seorang warga Italia, telah melakukan perjalanan ke Kosta Rika untuk menerima gelar doktor dari negara bagian Universitas Kosta Rika. Kantor hak asasi manusia PBB mengatakan pada X bahwa Albania dilarang masuk pada "tempat keamanan nasional diklaim". Pemerintah Kosta Rika menegaskan bahwa Albania adalah subjek dari "peringatan internasional atas link untuk aksi teroris". Seorang pengacara Italia, Albania adalah rapporteur khusus PBB pada situasi hak asasi manusia di wilayah Palestina, yang telah diduduki oleh Israel sejak 1967. Dia telah disetujui oleh Amerika Serikat sejak 2025. "Saya sangat marah bahwa pemerintah Kosta Rika telah menyebarkan informasi palsu yang menghubungkan saya dengan terorisme", kata orang Albania dari bandara, menambahkan bahwa dia berharap Costa Rica akan membalikkan keputusan. Duta besar PBB, Danny Danon, memuji keputusan Kosta Rica dalam sebuah pos di X. Dibawah Presiden Laura Fernandez, Kosta Rika telah memperdalam kerjasama dengan Amerika Serikat dalam keamanan dan pindah lebih dekat dengan Israel. Ini menandatangani perjanjian perdagangan bebas dengan Israel tahun lalu. Di sinilah aku akan menghabiskan malam pertamaku di Costa Rica. https: / / t.co / 9DbgdNOqDO - Francesca Albanese, UN Special Rapporteur oPt (@ FranceskAlbs) November 27, 2026
articles.originalTitle: UN rights chief voices concern as Costa Rica bars Francesca Albanese
articles.originalDescription: UN rights chief voices concern as Costa Rica bars Francesca Albanese Costa Rica denied entry to Francesca Albanese, the United Nations special rapporteur on the occupied Palestinian territory, drawing criticism from UN human rights chief Volker Turk on Friday. Turk said he was "deeply concerned" by Costa Rica's decision to bar Albanese from entering the country and urged authorities to reconsider after she was stopped at Juan Santamaria airport, which serves the capital San Jose. Albanese, an Italian national, had travelled to Costa Rica to receive an honorary doctorate from the state-run University of Costa Rica. The UN human rights office said on X that Albanese was denied entry on "claimed national security grounds". The government of Costa Rica asserted that Albanese was the subject of an "international alert over links to terrorist acts". An Italian lawyer, Albanese is the UN special rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territory, which has been occupied by Israel since 1967. She has been sanctioned by the United States since 2025. "I am deeply indignant that the government of Costa Rica has spread false information that links me to terrorism," Albanese said from the airport, adding that she hoped Costa Rica would reverse the decision. Israel's UN ambassador, Danny Danon, praised Costa Rica's decision in a post on X. Under President Laura Fernandez, Costa Rica has deepened cooperation with the United States on security and moved closer to Israel. It signed a free trade agreement with Israel last year. This is where I will spend my first night in Costa Rica. https://t.co/9DbgdNOqDO — Francesca Albanese, UN Special Rapporteur oPt (@FranceskAlbs) November 27, 2026

articles.title: Aliansi Pertahanan Mekah bersumpah untuk mempercepat upaya bersama untuk menjaga keamanan Arab Saudi
articles.description: ISLAMABAD - Komite Strategi Politik dan Pertahanan Aliansi Pertahanan Nabi menegaskan ketetapan untuk melanjutkan dan mempercepat upaya bersama untuk mendukung Saudi Arabia dalam menjaga keamanannya, sesuai dengan ketentuan pertahanan kolektif ditetapkan dalam perjanjian aliansi. Arab Saudi, Pakistan dan Türkiye mengadakan pertemuan kedua komite di Islamabad pada hari Jumat. Komite meninjau perkembangan keamanan regional dan menegaskan kembali tekad ketiga negara untuk terus bekerja sama untuk mencapai perdamaian, keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut. Ketiga negara memperbaharui komitmen mereka untuk prinsip-prinsip dan tujuan Perjanjian Pertahanan Gabungan Mekah, termasuk pertahanan kolektif, solidaritas bersama dan menghormati kedaulatan dan integritas setiap partai. Komite meninjau hasil pertemuan perdana nya, diadakan di Istanbul pada Augly 31, 2026, dan pertemuan darurat di Riyadh pada Oct. 5, 2026, serta kemajuan dibuat dalam menerapkan keputusan yang diadopsi selama dua pertemuan. Diskusi berfokus terutama dalam membangun framework institusi aliansi dan penerapan praktis komitmen pertahanan kolektif sesuai dengan undang-undang nasional. Komite memberikan laju kemajuan terhadap pembangunan dan operasional aliansi Sekretaris Umum di Arab Saudi, menekankan peran pentingnya dalam mendukung pekerjaan institusi dan memperkuat koordinasi efektif antar anggota negara. Komite juga meninjau hasil dari konsultasi politik dan militer yang sedang berlangsung dan setuju untuk melanjutkan konsultasi yang bertujuan untuk memperkuat kerjasama dan koordinasi mengenai kepentingan bersama. Ini menegaskan kembali dukungan untuk upaya untuk mengurangi ketegangan daerah yang meningkat dan mempromosikan penyelesaian damai perselisihan melalui dialog dan diplomasi. Komite menetapkan kembali hukuman yang kuat dari serangan brutal yang terus menargetkan warga sipil dan infrastruktur sipil di Arab Saudi. Ketiga negara juga memperbaharui komitmen mereka untuk memperkuat kerjasama

The report, published on Friday, reveals how President Donald Trump’s bid to boost production and lower energy prices amid the war on Iran put the US in direct conflict with Saudi Arabia, one of the US's closest allies in the region, which also sells its oil in US dollars and hosts US troops. The Trump administration’s lobbying over the summer also sheds new light on the decision of the UAE to leave Opec in May. The Trump administration welcomed the move at the time. Washington extended the option of a currency swap line to the UAE to allow the Emirates to access US dollars if its reserves ran dry. The rare gesture came shortly after the height of fighting between the US and Iran, when oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz had plunged. Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Venezuela, Iran and Kuwait were the founding members of Opec in 1960. Iran is already outside the cartel’s purview as a result of US sanctions and its so-called “shadow sale” of oil to China. The withdrawal of Iraq and Venezuela from the alliance would have effectively spelled Opec’s demise, although the alliance has been under pressure for years. articles.description: Serangan pesawat tak berawak Israel terhadap kendaraan membunuh orang Palestina di Utara Gaza seorang pria Palestina terbunuh dan beberapa lainnya terluka pada Jumat malam dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak Israel pada kendaraan di Jalur Gaza Utara, agen berita Palestina Wafa melaporkan. Penyerangan menabrak kendaraan di daerah Bir al- Naaja, sebelah barat kamp pengungsi Jabalia, membunuh Khaled Assaf, saksi mengatakan Wafa. Beberapa yang terluka dalam kondisi serius. Terpisah, seorang anak terluka oleh tembakan Israel di Khan Younis, di Jalur Gaza Selatan. Pasukan Israel ditempatkan di dekat perimeter timur daerah berulang kali menembak ke tenda melindungi pengungsi Palestina, melukai anak itu. Departemen Kesehatan Palestina mengatakan pada hari Kamis bahwa serangan Israel telah membunuh setidaknya 19 warga Palestina dan melukai 48 orang lainnya selama 48 jam terakhir. Serangan terakhir membawa jumlah warga Palestina yang tewas sejak gencatan senjata dimulai pada bulan Oktober tahun lalu hingga 1.705.
articles.originalTitle: Israeli drone strike on vehicle kills Palestinian man in northern Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Israeli drone strike on vehicle kills Palestinian man in northern Gaza A Palestinian man was killed and several others were wounded on Friday evening in an Israeli drone strike on a vehicle in the northern Gaza Strip, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. The strike hit the vehicle in the Bir al-Naaja area, west of the Jabalia refugee camp, killing Khaled Assaf, witnesses told Wafa. Some of the wounded were in serious condition. Separately, a child was wounded by Israeli gunfire in Khan Younis, in the southern Gaza Strip. Israeli forces stationed near the area's eastern perimeter repeatedly opened fire towards tents sheltering displaced Palestinians, wounding the child. The Palestinian health ministry said on Thursday that Israeli attacks had killed at least 19 Palestinians and wounded 48 others over the past 48 hours. The latest attacks brought the total number of Palestinians killed since the so-called ceasefire began in October last year to 1,705.

articles.title: Grup Pro- Israel merek US Gaza Advert 'antisemitic Hamas propaganda'
articles.description: Grup Pro- Israel merek US Gaza Advert 'antisemitic Hamas propaganda' Sebuah iklan 30 detik yang menyoroti pendanaan pembayar pajak AS untuk Israel disiarkan di seluruh Amerika Serikat pada Rabu malam selama edisi spesial Thanksgiving dari sketsa panjang menunjukkan Saturday Night Live. Iklannya, dari Institute for Middle East Understanding Policy Project (Imeu), sebuah grup advokasi pro- Palestina yang berbasis di California, menunjukkan seorang gadis Amerika melaksanakan tugas selama setahun ini untuk membuat $400 untuk membeli sepeda baru. Rekaman ini diambil dari orang Amerika di jalan pinggiran kota yang murni bagi seorang gadis Palestina di tengah puing-puing Gaza. Gadis Palestina telah kehilangan kaki untuk bom Israel dan pada kruk. "Setiap tiga detik, pemerintah kita mengirimkan $400 uang pembayar pajak kepada Israel untuk melakukan hal ini", kata narator Amerika iklan, melawan latar belakang gadis di Gaza. AS secara resmi memberikan Israel $3.8bn setahun, dalam 10 tahun memorandum pemahaman yang berjalan dari 2019 sampai 2028, bekerja di lebih dari $360 setiap tiga detik. Baca lebih lanjut: penyiar AS mengudara iklan menyoroti bantuan militer untuk Israel selama Saturday Night Live
articles.originalTitle: Pro-Israel groups brand US Gaza advert 'antisemitic Hamas propaganda'
articles.originalDescription: Pro-Israel groups brand US Gaza advert 'antisemitic Hamas propaganda' A 30-second advert highlighting US taxpayer funding for Israel was broadcast across the United States on Wednesday night during a Thanksgiving special edition of the long-running sketch show Saturday Night Live. The ad, from the Institute for Middle East Understanding Policy Project (Imeu), a pro- Palestinian advocacy group based in California, shows an American girl carrying out chores over the course of the year in order to make $400 to buy a new bicycle. The footage then cuts from the American on a pristine suburban street to a Palestinian girl amid the rubble of Gaza. The Palestinian girl has lost a leg to Israeli bombs and is on crutches. “Every three seconds, our government sends $400 of taxpayer money to Israel to do this,” says the ad's American narrator, against the backdrop of the girl in Gaza. The US currently officially gives Israel $3.8bn a year, in a 10-year memorandum of understanding that runs from 2019 to 2028, working out at just over $360 every three seconds. Read more: US broadcaster airs ad highlighting military aid to Israel during Saturday Night Live

articles.title: Apa yang akan berubah bagi Israel, Aljazair dan Maroko jika sayap kanan Spanyol memenangkan pemilu
articles.description: Apa yang akan berubah bagi Israel, Aljazair dan Maroko jika Spanyol memenangkan pemilihan sayap-kanan "Pemerintah Israel memiliki semua dukungan, kasih sayang dan pengertian kami," Santiago Abascal, pemimpin partai Vox kanan Spanyol, mengatakan selama perjalanan ke Israel pada Desember 2023. Ketika Abascal mengunjungi Israel dalam sebuah acara dukungan dan untuk mencari dukungan politik dari Perdana Menteri Benjamin Netanyahu, pasukan Israel telah membunuh lebih dari 16,248 orang Palestina di Gaza, menurut gambaran yang dikutip oleh kantor kemanusiaan PBB, OCHA. Sekitar 70 persen adalah wanita dan anak-anak. Spanyol suara pada hari Minggu, dengan jajak pendapat memprediksi bahwa Vox akan hampir dua kali lipat nya perwakilan parlemen dari 33 kursi ke 61. Itu akan membantu Partai Rakyat Kanan-Kanan (PP), proyek jajak pendapat yang akan memenangkan 129 kursi, merakit koalisi nyaman di atas mayoritas 176- kursi diperlukan untuk unseat Perdana Menteri Pedro Sanchez pusat pemerintahan kiri. Pemilu juga dapat mengubah kebijakan luar negeri Spanyol, termasuk hubungannya dengan Presiden AS Donald Trump, hubungan tegang dengan Maroko dan hubungan buruknya dengan Israel atas genosida di Gaza dan kebijakan apartheid yang sedang berlangsung di Tepi Barat yang diduduki. Baca lagi: Sebagai mata kanan Spanyol kekuasaan, apa yang akan berubah untuk Israel, Maroko dan Aljazair?
articles.originalTitle: What will change for Israel, Algeria and Morocco if Spain's right-wing wins elections
articles.originalDescription: What will change for Israel, Algeria and Morocco if Spain's right-wing wins elections “The Israeli government has all our support, affection and understanding,” Santiago Abascal, leader of Spain’s far-right Vox party, said during a trip to Israel in December 2023. While Abascal visited Israel in a show of support and to seek political backing from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Israeli forces had killed more than 16,248 Palestinians in Gaza, according to figures cited by the UN humanitarian office, OCHA. About 70 percent were women and children. Spain votes on Sunday, with polls predicting that Vox will almost double its parliamentary representation from 33 seats to 61. That would help the centre-right People’s Party (PP), which polls project will win 129 seats, assemble a coalition comfortably above the 176-seat majority needed to unseat Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez’s centre-left government. The election could also change Spain’s foreign policy, including its relationship with US President Donald Trump, its tense relations with Morocco and its deteriorating ties with Israel over the genocide in Gaza and ongoing apartheid policies in the occupied West Bank. Read more: As Spain’s right eyes power, what would change for Israel, Morocco and Algeria?

articles.title: Bagaimana kehidupan Palestina di Yerusalem Timur dipadamkan
articles.description: Bagaimana kehidupan Palestina di Yerusalem Timur dipadamkan adalah langkah pertama dalam melikuidasi orang adalah menghapus ingatannya. Hancurkan bukunya, budayanya, sejarahnya. Lalu suruh seseorang menulis buku baru, membuat budaya baru, menemukan sejarah baru ", tulis novelis Ceko Milan Kundera." Sebelum lama bangsa itu akan mulai melupakan apa itu dan apa itu. Dunia di sekitarnya akan lebih cepat melupakan ". Subyek Kundera adalah Cekoslowakia di bawah komunisme Soviet. Kata-katanya juga berlaku untuk hidup karena tinggal di Yerusalem Timur hari ini di bawah pendudukan Israel. Sebuah kota padam di mana orang hidup ditinggalkan hidup putus asa yang tenang. Bagi orang Palestina, setiap bentuk politik telah menjadi berbahaya. Semua aktivitas politik - pertemuan kampanye, konferensi pers, mengumpulkan - dilarang dan dihukum oleh penjara. Gubernur Yerusalem yang ditunjuk oleh Otoritas Palestina (PA), Adnan Ghaith, pernah menjadi aktivis politik sibuk di sebelah tenggara Silwan dari Old City, telah ditangkap 37 kali dalam tujuh tahun jabatannya. Pengungkapan dan pemusnahan: Bagaimana kehidupan Palestina di Yerusalem Timur dipadamkan, oleh Peter Oborne di Yerusalem
articles.originalTitle: How Palestinian life in East Jerusalem is being extinguished
articles.originalDescription: How Palestinian life in East Jerusalem is being extinguished "The first step in liquidating a people is to erase its memory. Destroy its books, its culture, its history. Then have somebody write new books, manufacture a new culture, invent a new history,” wrote the Czech novelist Milan Kundera. “Before long that nation will begin to forget what it is and what it was. The world around it will forget even faster.” Kundera’s subject was Czechoslovakia under Soviet communism. His words also apply to life as it is lived in East Jerusalem today under Israeli occupation. An extinguished city where people live abandoned lives of quiet desperation. For Palestinians , any form of politics has become dangerous. All political activity - campaign meetings, press conferences, canvassing - is banned and punishable by jail. The governor of Jerusalem appointed by the Palestinian Authority (PA), Adnan Ghaith, once a busy political activist in the Silwan neighbourhood southeast of the Old City, has been arrested 37 times in his seven years in office. Evictions and erasure: How Palestinian life in East Jerusalem is being extinguished, by Peter Oborne in Jerusalem

articles.title: Pemerintah Inggris menghapus catatan pertemuan antara Blair dan Shabana Mahmood
articles.description: Pemerintah Inggris menghapus catatan pertemuan antara Blair dan Shabana Mahmood Pemerintah Inggris menghapus catatan pertemuan antara mantan perdana menteri Tony Blair dan Sekretaris Dalam Negeri Shabana Mahmood, menurut Demokrasi untuk surat kabar Sale. Pertemuan, yang berlangsung pada bulan Juni 2025 ketika Mahmood adalah sekretaris keadilan, awalnya dinyatakan sebagai bisnis resmi pemerintah, dengan tujuannya terdaftar sebagai "keterlibatan pemegang saham". Tapi ketika kami meminta rincian tentang apa yang dibahas di bawah Freedom of Information Act, Departemen Kehakiman mengatakan Demokrasi untuk Sale itu adalah pertemuan "pesta-politik" dan bahwa tidak ada catatan itu ada. Beberapa hari setelah surat kabar meminta pemerintah untuk berkomentar, pertemuan menghilang dari daftar publik. Blair adalah anggota dari Presiden AS Donald Trump 's Gaza "Board of Peace", sementara Mahmood telah mendorong undang-undang semakin draconian pada migrasi dan mempertahankan larangan pemerintah pada Aksi Palestina. Pemerintah menghapus catatan pertemuan antara Tony Blair dan Shabana Mahmood beberapa hari setelah kami menanyakannya ini bukan hanya pertemuan Blair + menteri kami telah menemukan bahwa mengumpulkan pertanyaan tentang catatan transparansi buruh: / / t.co / BvLV0KlsdR - Peter Geoghigan (@ Peter Kgeoghigan) November 27, 2026
articles.originalTitle: UK government deleted record of meeting between Blair and Shabana Mahmood
articles.originalDescription: UK government deleted record of meeting between Blair and Shabana Mahmood The British government deleted the record of a meeting between former prime minister Tony Blair and Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood, according to the Democracy for Sale newsletter . The meeting, which took place in June 2025 when Mahmood was justice secretary, was originally declared as official government business, with its purpose listed as "stakeholder engagement". But when we asked for details of what was discussed under the Freedom of Information Act, the Ministry of Justice told Democracy for Sale it was a "party-political" meeting and that no records of it existed. Several days after the newsletter asked the government for comment, the meeting disappeared from the public register. Blair is a member of US President Donald Trump's Gaza "Board of Peace", while Mahmood has pushed for increasingly draconian legislation on migration and maintained the government's ban on Palestine Action. 🔴 SCOOP: Government deleted record of a meeting between Tony Blair and Shabana Mahmood days after we asked about it It's not only meeting between Blair meetings + ministers we've uncovered that raise questions about Labour's transparency records 🧵 https://t.co/BvLV0KlsdR — Peter Geoghegan (@PeterKGeoghegan) November 27, 2026

articles.description: RIYADH - Kuwait, Bahrain, Aljazair dan Liga Dunia Muslim (MWL) mengutuk serangan terus-menerus terhadap Arab Saudi, di antara penghukuman atas serangan Houthi pada kilang minyak dan pelabuhan Jazan. Dalam pernyataan yang dikeluarkan pada hari Jumat, Kementerian Luar Negeri Kuwait dengan tegas mengutuk dan mengecam serangan teroris yang berkelanjutan oleh milisi Houthi melawan Arab Saudi, termasuk serangan terhadap kilang minyak Jazan, yang menewaskan satu pekerja dan melukai beberapa lainnya, serta serangan terhadap Pelabuhan Jazan. Menteri menggambarkan serangan itu sebagai pelanggaran berat atas kedaulatan Kerajaan dan pelanggaran berat hukum internasional dan hukum kemanusiaan internasional. Kuwait menekankan penolakan kategorik terhadap serangan yang menargetkan warga sipil, objek sipil dan fasilitas penting, peringatan bahwa tindakan tersebut merupakan eskalasi berbahaya dan mengancam keamanan daerah dan stabilitas, serta keamanan pasokan energi global. Menteri menegaskan kembali solidaritas mutlak Kuwait dengan Arab Saudi dan dukungannya untuk segala tindakan yang diambil oleh Kerajaan untuk menjaga kedaulatan, keamanan dan stabilitas. Bahrain juga mengutuk serangan oleh milisi teroris Amerika Serikat terhadap fasilitas sipil dan ekonomi dan benda-benda di Arab Saudi, termasuk serangan terhadap kilang minyak Jazan, yang menewaskan pekerja Nepal dan melukai orang lain dari berbagai negara, dan serangan terhadap Pelabuhan Jazan. Departemen Luar Negeri Bahrain juga disebut mencoba menyerang situs sasaran di Ras Tanura, di sekitar Pelabuhan Jeddah Islam, Riyadh dan daerah-daerah lainnya di Kerajaan, yang dicegat dan digagalkan oleh pertahanan udara Saudi. articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Kuwait, Bahrain, Algeria and the Muslim World League (MWL) condemned the continued attacks against Saudi Arabia, amid mounting condemnation of the Houthi attacks on the Jazan oil refinery and port. The ministry reaffirmed Kuwait’s absolute solidarity with Saudi Arabia and its support for all measures taken by the Kingdom to safeguard its sovereignty, security and stability. Bahrain also condemned attacks by the Iranian-backed Houthi terrorist militia against civilian and economic facilities and objects in Saudi Arabia, including the attack on the Jazan oil refinery, which killed a Nepali worker and injured others of various nationalities, and the attack on Jazan Port. articles.title: Arab Saudi terpilih menjadi ketua OIC Pekerjaan Keselamatan dan Jaringan Kesehatan untuk dua tahun
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi telah terpilih untuk memimpin Organisasi Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja Islam (OIC-OSHNET) untuk jangka dua tahun, diwakili oleh Dewan Nasional untuk Keselamatan Kerja dan Kesehatan (NCOSH). Pemilu berlangsung selama pertemuan tahunan jaringan pada 23 November, yang membawa bersama-sama perwakilan dari anggota negara-negara OIC dan khusus internasional dan organisasi regional di bawah tema "Melanjutkan Prioritas Bersama dalam Keselamatan Kerja dan Kesehatan". Anggota-anggota juga memilih Malaysia dan Senegal sebagai ketua dan menyetujui pemerintah jaringan dan pengaturan operasional untuk meningkatkan koordinasi institusi dan kerjasama teknis. Di bawah kepemimpinannya, Arab Saudi akan bekerja sama dengan negara-negara anggota, membangun prioritas umum, mengembangkan inisiatif pencegahan risiko pekerjaan dan mengembangkan program membangun kapasitas dan pertukaran keahlian. * * media [2800550] * * Selama pertemuan, the Kingdom menguraikan usahanya untuk memperkuat keamanan dan sistem kesehatan nasionalnya, menyoroti peran regulasi dan koordinasi NCOSH dan kontribusi regional melalui Framework Strategi Teluk untuk Keselamatan Kerja dan Kesehatan (2025- 2030). Keahlian kepemimpinan membangun upaya Arab Saudi untuk meningkatkan keamanan tempat kerja melalui pengembangan legislatif, langkah-langkah pencegahan dan keterlibatan yang lebih besar dengan keamanan pekerjaan dan kebutuhan kesehatan, sejalan dengan Saudi Vision 2030. Organisasi-organisasi yang berpartisipasi termasuk Organisasi Buruh Internasional (ILO), Asosiasi Keamanan Sosial Internasional (ISA), Organisasi Karyawan Internasional (IOE) dan Badan Keamanan dan Kesehatan Eropa di Kantor (EU-OSHA). Operasi di bawah Pusat Buruh OIC, jaringan mengumpulkan 57 negara anggota untuk mengatasi risiko pekerjaan melalui inisiatif bersama, berbagi pengetahuan dan pengembangan kemampuan institusional dan teknis.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia elected to chair OIC Occupational Safety and Health Network for two-year term
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has been elected to chair the Organization of Islamic Cooperation’s Occupational Safety and Health Network (OIC-OSHNET) for a two-year term, represented by the National Council for Occupational Safety and Health (NCOSH). The election took place during the network’s annual meeting on November 23, which brought together representatives of OIC member states and specialized international and regional organizations under the theme “Towards Shared Priorities in Occupational Safety and Health.” Members also elected Malaysia and Senegal as vice-chairs and approved the network’s governance and operational arrangements to enhance institutional coordination and technical cooperation. Under its chairmanship, Saudi Arabia will work to advance cooperation among member states, establish common priorities, develop occupational risk prevention initiatives and expand capacity-building programs and the exchange of expertise. **media[2800550]** During the meeting, the Kingdom outlined its efforts to strengthen its national occupational safety and health system, highlighting NCOSH’s regulatory and coordination role and its regional contributions through the Gulf Strategic Framework for Occupational Safety and Health (2025–2030). The chairmanship builds on Saudi Arabia’s efforts to improve workplace safety through legislative development, preventive measures and greater compliance with occupational safety and health requirements, in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Participating organizations included the International Labour Organization (ILO), the International Social Security Association (ISSA), the International Organisation of Employers (IOE) and the European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA). Operating under the OIC Labour Centre, the network brings together 57 member states to address occupational risks through joint initiatives, knowledge sharing and the development of institutional and technical capabilities.

Setelah menderita demam tinggi, mencapai 39C, dan berulang pembengkakan perut, bayi Palestina didiagnosis dengan meningitis. "Ini dimulai dengan ruam kulit dan demam tinggi, dengan suhu mencapai 39C," ibunya, Amal, mengatakan Mata Timur Tengah. "Setiap hari, dokter melakukan scan medis dan tes laboratorium", katanya kondisinya telah menunjukkan sedikit perbaikan, sebagian besar karena kekurangan obat-obatan penting. Halladin adalah salah satu anak yang baru-baru ini untuk mengembangkan meningitis di tengah-tengah lonjakan dalam kasus di seluruh daerah perang, di mana Israel memiliki semua tetapi menghancurkan sistem kesehatan dan terus melarang obat-obatan penting. Kantor PBB untuk Koordinat Urusan Kemanusiaan (Ocha) melaporkan 413 kasus meningitis yang diduga di Gaza antara 27 September dan 31 Oktober, termasuk 294 virus dan 119 kasus bakteri. Laporan mengatakan 68 persen direkam di Gaza City. Pada hari Selasa, Kementerian Kesehatan Palestina mengumumkan "peringatan wabah" di seluruh Gaza, mengutip peningkatan tajam dalam kasus meningitis dan kematian. Departemen mengatakan 1.790 orang telah didiagnosis dengan meningitis sejak awal tahun, dengan 15 kematian dicatat. Pada bulan Oktober saja, setidaknya 272 infeksi dikonfirmasi. Risiko penyakit menular meningkat di tengah penampungan perpindahan yang penuh sesak, air minum yang tidak aman, sistem sanitasi yang rusak dan keruntuhan layanan kesehatan penting di seluruh Gaza. articles.originalTitle: Gaza’s children caught in the grip of a meningitis outbreak
articles.originalDescription: Gaza’s children caught in the grip of a meningitis outbreak Submitted by Hani Abu Rezeq on Fri, 11/27/2026 - 08:11 Contaminated water, collapse of healthcare system and scarce medical supplies are fuelling a surge in infections across the besieged enclave Nine-month-old Mohammed, who is being treated for meningitis, sits on his mother Reham Wahdan’s lap at Al-Rantisi Hospital in Gaza City (Hani Abu Rezeq/MEE) Off For 10 days, two-month-old Mostafa Hallawin has been bedridden at Al-Rantisi Children’s Hospital in Gaza City. After suffering a persistent high fever, reaching 39C, and recurring abdominal swelling, the Palestinian infant was diagnosed with meningitis. “It started with a skin rash and a high fever, with his temperature reaching 39C,” his mother, Amal, told Middle East Eye. “Every day, doctors perform medical scans and laboratory tests,” she added, saying his condition has shown little improvement, largely because of shortages of essential medicines. Hallawin is one of the most recent children to develop meningitis amid a spike in cases across the war-torn enclave, where Israel has all but destroyed the healthcare system and continues to ban essential medicines. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha) reported 413 suspected meningitis cases in Gaza between 27 September and 31 October, including 294 viral and 119 bacterial cases. The report said 68 percent were recorded in Gaza City. On Tuesday, the Palestinian Health Ministry declared an "epidemic alert" across Gaza, citing a sharp rise in meningitis cases and deaths. The ministry said 1,790 people had been diagnosed with meningitis since the beginning of the year, with 15 deaths recorded. In October alone, at least 272 infections were confirmed. The risk of infectious diseases has increased amid overcrowded displacement shelters, unsafe drinking water, damaged sanitation systems and the collapse of essential healthcare services across Gaza. articles.originalTitle: Several countries slam suspected Iranian attack on Kuwait
articles.originalDescription: Several countries slam suspected Iranian attack on Kuwait A number of countries and their officials have condemned the latest drone attacks launched against Kuwait, which killed two Italian nationals. The UK minister Stephen Doughty condemned the attack as "utterly unacceptable" and said that his country "stands firmly with Kuwait, Italy and all those affected, without making mention of who could be behind the attacks. The Syrian Foreign Ministry slammed Iran for the strikes, and affirmed its "full solidarity" with Kuwait. It also extended its condolences to the families of those killed. Similarly, Saudi Arabia has also pinned the attacks on Iran, saying: "The continued Iranian attacks further exacerbate tensions and undermine stability." Iran has denied the allegations that it launched the drones on Kuwait, with Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi calling the incident "suspicious".

articles.originalTitle: Settlers smash foundations of Palestinian family's homes in West Bank
articles.originalDescription: Settlers smash foundations of Palestinian family's homes in West Bank Israeli settlers smashed the foundations of two homes belonging to a Palestinian family in the occupied West Bank on Thursday, after settler attacks prevented the family from returning to them, in defiance of an Israeli court order. Security cameras showed the settlers bringing a bulldozer to the hilltop two-storey houses on either side of a road in the village of Jaloud after midnight and spending about an hour damaging the houses. The family said it had been forced out months ago. "This latest escalation is a direct consequence of the lack of law enforcement and the sense of impunity enjoyed by the perpetrators," said Ghiath Nasser, a lawyer representing the owners of the houses in court. The demolition follows a surge of settler violence in which settlers have encroached on Palestinian villages, with an average of 53 settler attacks per week since the start of 2026, according to UN figures. Reporting by Reuters

articles.description: Mengapa film ini tidak seperti yang kau pikirkan tentang Diberikan oleh Mohamed Hashem pada Thu, 11 / 26 / 2026 - 20: 40 "Dokter Amerika selalu dimaksudkan untuk menjadi umpan, kuda Trojan". Di permukaan, Dokter Amerika adalah film tentang tiga dokter Amerika yang mengajukan diri di rumah sakit Gaza selama perang Israel. Tapi untuk direktur Poh Si Teng, judul itu selalu menjadi sebuah jalan masuk: sebuah film untuk menjangkau penonton di Barat, tentang pekerja kesehatan Palestina dan AS membuat bom yang jatuh pada mereka. Film ini mengikuti ahli bedah trauma Dr Feroze Sidhwa, Palestina - Amerika dokter darurat Dr Thaer Ahmad dan Dr Mark Perlmutter, dari rumah sakit Gaza ke aula kekuasaan di Washington. Dalam wawancara Real Talk ini, Poh, Feroze dan Thaer duduk dengan Mohamed Hashem untuk berbicara tentang pemikiran di balik judul, pengarahan Joe Biden di Rafah, dan mengapa para penyandang dana melihat film itu sebagai "risiko institusi". Real Talk Video Post Date Override 0 Update Date Mon, 05 / 04 / 2020 - 21: 29 Update Override 0
articles.originalTitle: American Doctor: Why this film isn’t what you think it’s about
articles.originalDescription: American Doctor: Why this film isn’t what you think it’s about Submitted by Mohamed Hashem on Thu, 11/26/2026 - 20:40 "American Doctor was always meant to be a decoy, a Trojan horse." On the surface, American Doctor is a film about three American doctors who volunteered in Gaza's hospitals during Israel's war. But for director Poh Si Teng, the title was always a way in: a film to reach audiences in the West, about Palestinian health workers and the US-made bombs falling on them. The film follows trauma surgeon Dr Feroze Sidhwa, Palestinian-American emergency physician Dr Thaer Ahmad and Dr Mark Perlmutter, from Gaza's hospitals to the halls of power in Washington. In this Real Talk interview, Poh, Feroze and Thaer sit down with Mohamed Hashem to talk about the thinking behind the title, briefing Joe Biden on Rafah, and why funders saw the film as an "institutional risk". articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Luar Negeri menyatakan hukuman Arab Saudi dan pengungkapan dalam kondisi yang terkuat dari agresi kejam Iran terhadap Kuwait, yang menargetkan situs penting, mengakibatkan beberapa kematian dan cedera. Dalam sebuah pernyataan, pelayanan tersebut berkata: "Serangan Iran yang berlanjut menyebabkan ketegangan dan ketidakstabilan. The Kingdom menegaskan kembali bahwa pelanggaran ini melemahkan upaya internasional ditujukan untuk memulihkan keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut." articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed Saudi Arabia's condemnation and denunciation in the strongest terms of Iran's heinous aggression against Kuwait, which targeted a vital site, resulting in several deaths and injuries. In a statement, the ministry said: “The continued Iranian attacks lead to further tensions and instability. The Kingdom reiterates that these violations undermine international efforts aimed at restoring security and stability in the region.”Saudi Arabia held Iran responsible for the consequences of its continued brutal attacks. It demanded an immediate cessation of these violations while reaffirming its full solidarity with Kuwait in all measures it takes to safeguard its sovereignty.

articles.title: Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota menawarkan belasungkawa kepada presiden Mesir atas Giza tragedi kebakaran
articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga dari dua Mosques Kudus Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman telah menawarkan belasungkawa kepada Presiden Mesir Abdel Fattah El- Sisi atas korban kebakaran di Al- Wasraq distrik di pemerintah Giza. Dengan kabel terpisah dikirim ke El- Simi, Raja dan Putra Mahkota menyatakan belasungkawa terdalam mereka dan tulus simpati kepada presiden, keluarga dari almarhum, dan orang-orang Mesir. Mereka berdoa kepada Allah Maha Kuasa untuk memberikan Belas kasihnya yang berlimpah pada almarhum, hibur keluarga mereka kesabaran dan pelipur lara, berkati yang terluka dengan pemulihan cepat, dan lindungi presiden dan rakyat Mesir dari segala bahaya. Ketiga puluh - satu orang telah tewas, dengan 21 lainnya terluka, setelah truk bahan bakar terbalik memicu api besar. Insiden ini terjadi ketika sebuah truk sedang bepergian dari distrik El- Marg Kairo di Jalan Ring Warraq dekat Giza, sekitar 12 mil jauhnya dari Piramida Agung terkenal, pada malam hari Rabu.
articles.originalTitle: King Salman and Crown Prince offer condolences to Egyptian president over Giza fire tragedy
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman have offered condolences to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi over the victims of the fire in Al-Warraq district in the Giza governorate.In separate cables sent to El-Sisi, the King and the Crown Prince expressed their deepest condolences and sincere sympathy to the president, the families of the deceased, and the people of Egypt. They prayed to God Almighty to bestow His abundant mercy and forgiveness upon the deceased, grant their families patience and solace, bless the injured with a speedy recovery, and protect the president and the people of Egypt from all harm. Thirty-one people have been killed, with another 21 injured, after a fuel truck overturned sparking a huge fire. The incident occurred when a truck was traveling from Cairo’s El-Marg district on the Warraq Ring Road near Giza, about 12 miles away from the famous Great Pyramid, on the evening of Wednesday.

articles.description: RIYADH - Wakil Menteri Urusan Politik di Kementerian Luar Negeri Dr Saud Al- Sati bertemu dengan duta besar negara yang diakreditasi ke Arab Saudi di kantor pusat kementerian di Riyadh pada hari Rabu dan Kamis. Mayor Jenderal Turki Al- Maliki, juru bicara Koalisi untuk mendukung Legitimasi di Yaman, menghadiri pertemuan. * * media [2800395] * * Duta-duta telah diberitahu tentang serangan terakhir oleh milisi Houthi teroris menargetkan warga sipil, objek sipil, dan fasilitas penting di Kerajaan. Dua pejabat mengatakan serangan itu merupakan pelanggaran hukum internasional dan tindakan teroris yang sengaja mengancam keamanan, keamanan, dan kehidupan warga sipil. Mereka menegaskan bahwa Kerajaan akan mengambil langkah-langkah yang diperlukan untuk melindungi keamanannya dan keamanan warganya. Mereka juga menekankan bahwa Kerajaan akan terus mendukung rakyat Yaman dan pemerintah sah mereka dalam menghadapi serangan Militia. Para duta besar menegaskan kembali negara mereka 'mengutuk serangan. Mereka menyatakan solidaritas dengan Kerajaan dalam ukuran yang diperlukan untuk melawan serangan, dan menegaskan dukungan mereka untuk keamanan dan stabilitas.
articles.originalTitle: Deputy foreign minister briefs ambassadors on Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Deputy Minister for Political Affairs at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Ambassador Dr. Saud Al-Sati met with ambassadors of countries accredited to Saudi Arabia at the ministry’s headquarters in Riyadh on Wednesday and Thursday. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, spokesman of the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, attended the meetings. **media[2800395]** The ambassadors were briefed on the latest attacks by the terrorist Houthi militia targeting civilians, civilian objects, and vital facilities in the Kingdom. The two officials said the attacks constitute a flagrant violation of international law and are terrorist acts that deliberately threaten the security, safety, and lives of civilians. They affirmed that the Kingdom will take the necessary measures to protect its security and the safety of its citizens and residents. They also stressed that the Kingdom will continue to support the Yemeni people and their legitimate government in confronting the militia’s attacks. The ambassadors reiterated their countries’ condemnation of the attacks. They expressed solidarity with the Kingdom in the measures it is taking to counter the attacks, and affirmed their support for its security and stability.

articles.originalTitle: UK Jewish group files challenge against Hamas terror designation
articles.originalDescription: UK Jewish group files challenge against Hamas terror designation A Jewish-led organisation has launched a challenge against Britain’s designation of Hamas as a terrorist organisation, arguing that it has been used to target people expressing support for Palestinian rights, including Jewish activists who oppose the group. The Jewish Network for Palestine (JNP) submitted an application to the home secretary on Thursday, seeking to remove Hamas from the list of proscribed organisations under Section 4 of the Terrorism Act 2000. The application comes five years after the UK government expanded its ban on Hamas from the group’s armed wing to the organisation in its entirety. Read more: UK Jewish group files challenge against Hamas terror designation British police arresting a Jewish activist who opposes the designation of Palestine Action as a terror organisation (Reuters)

articles.title: Rumah sakit Gaza menerima 19 mayat Palestina dalam 48 jam terakhir
articles.description: Rumah sakit Gaza menerima 19 mayat Palestina dalam 48 jam terakhir di seluruh Gaza telah menerima sisa-sisa 19 orang Palestina selama 48 jam terakhir, laporan Wafa, mengutip sumber medis. Menurut laporan, 48 orang terluka lainnya dipindahkan ke fasilitas medis untuk pengobatan. Ini adalah lima orang Palestina, termasuk wakil menteri pendidikan, tewas dalam dua serangan Israel menargetkan sebuah apartemen di sebuah bangunan perumahan di pusat kota Deir Al- Balah, dan kamp pengungsi di Gaza. Setidaknya 1.705 orang Palestina telah terbunuh dan 6,163 lainnya terluka dalam serangan Israel sejak gencatan senjata terjadi pada bulan Oktober tahun lalu. Tim darurat telah menemukan mayat 851 orang, tapi lebih banyak lagi yang terjebak di bawah puing-puing.
articles.originalTitle: Gaza hospitals receive bodies of 19 Palestinians in last 48 hours
articles.originalDescription: Gaza hospitals receive bodies of 19 Palestinians in last 48 hours Hospitals across Gaza have received the remains of 19 Palestinians over the last 48 hours, Wafa reports, citing medical sources. According to the report, another 48 wounded people were transferred to medical facilities for treatment. This comes as five Palestinians, including the deputy education minister, were killed in two Israeli attacks targeting an apartment in a residential building in the central city of Deir al-Balah, and al-Shati refugee camp in Gaza's north. At least 1,705 Palestinians have been killed and another 6,163 wounded in Israeli attacks since the so-called ceasefire took effect in October last year. Emergency teams have recovered the bodies of 851 people, but warn many more remain trapped beneath the debris.

articles.title: Kementerian Energi: satu tewas, beberapa terluka dalam serangan kilang Jazan
articles.description: RIYADH - Seorang pekerja Nepal tewas dan beberapa lainnya terluka setelah serangan di kilang minyak Jazan, sumber resmi di Kementerian Energi mengatakan, menunjukkan informasi awal. Sebuah proyektil udara bermusuhan menghantam kilang minyak Jazan di wilayah Jazan pada hari Kamis, sumber mengatakan. "Serangan itu menyebabkan kebakaran, yang telah dipadamkan, dan sementara dihentikan beberapa operasi di kilang. Yang terluka menerima perawatan medis", kata sumbernya. Tim darurat dan kru teknis khusus merespon segera. Mereka menilai, dalam koordinasi dengan pihak berwenang yang terkait, kerusakan dan memeriksa keamanan fasilitas, sumber mengatakan sambil menyampaikan belasungkawa kepada keluarga almarhum dan berharap yang terluka pemulihan cepat.
articles.originalTitle: Energy Ministry: One killed, several injured in Jazan refinery attack
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — A Nepalese worker was killed and several others injured after an attack on Jazan oil refinery, an official source at the Ministry of Energy said, indicating preliminary information. A hostile aerial projectile struck the Jazan oil refinery in the Jazan region on Thursday, the source said. “The attack caused a fire, which has been put out, and temporarily halted some operations at the refinery. The injured are receiving medical care,” the source said.Emergency teams and specialized technical crews responded immediately. They are assessing, in coordination with the relevant authorities, the damage and checking the safety of the facilities, the source said while extending condolences to the family of the deceased and wishing the injured a speedy recovery.

articles.originalDescription: UAE's Lana Nusseibeh says she doesn't work for the UAE Submitted by Oscar Rickett on Thu, 11/26/2026 - 13:05 UN secretary-general candidate, employed by UAE government for 20 years, tells MEE she's on a 'leave of absence' Jeremy Bowen (l) and Lana Nusseibeh (r) at the UNA-UK event in London, 25 November 2026 (X/Lana Nusseibeh) Off Lana Nusseibeh has a cold. “Welcome to London,” she says. This, after all, is a place where people get colds. The Emirati diplomat has been running a relentless campaign to become the UN’s next secretary-general for more than a month now. The race remains deadlocked. In the last informal straw poll conducted to help determine who should replace Antonio Guterres, China , France and the UK - who can all veto a candidate - voted to “discourage” Nusseibeh's appointment. Perhaps sensing that the UK government’s opposition to her is fragile, Nusseibeh is in the British capital to lobby politicians and make her case to the press and civil society. While Ed Miliband and his foreign office is believed not to favour her, the Treasury - described by former Conservative party leader Iain Duncan Smith, who was visited by Nusseibeh, as “the most powerful department in government” - does not want to upset an extremely wealthy ally, particularly not one referred to by Prime Minister Andy Burnham as a "huge" partner . On Wednesday evening, Nusseibeh was sitting alongside host Jeremy Bowen at an event organised by the United Nations Association-UK. In a small room in a large building in Whitehall, which for almost 500 years has been the centre of British power, Nusseibeh was asked repeatedly to address the elephant in the room: the United Arab Emirates ’ involvement in the war in Sudan . Lobbying and denial The questions are personal to Nusseibeh. Soldiers described sending unarmed civilians ahead of troops to search for fighters and explosives in a practice they called the "Mosquito Protocol". The investigation, broadcast by public channel Kan on Wednesday, featured testimonies from several officers and combatants. They described how Palestinian civilians, arrested at checkpoints and elsewhere, were handcuffed and forced to search buildings and tunnels before Israeli troops entered. “The need to use the ‘shawish’ was to make the explosive device detonate on him rather than, God forbid, on a soldier,” one officer said, referring to Palestinian prisoners. “I will always prefer Israeli army soldiers over citizens of an enemy state,” he added. All the officers interviewed appeared with their faces blurred and were identified by pseudonyms. The programme had already sparked outrage among ministers and lawmakers before its broadcast, with some calling for it to be censored or cancelled. Defence Minister Israel Katz said the report could “damage the good name of soldiers and commanders, and even expose them to legal risks in the international arena”. articles.title: Arab Saudi membunyikan alarm di UNSC atas penyalahgunaan teroris teknologi yang muncul
articles.description: NEW YORK - Arab Saudi memperingatkan terhadap eksploitasi teknologi yang muncul oleh kelompok-kelompok teroris, termasuk komponen yang dapat digunakan untuk mengembangkan kemampuan militer. Kata-kata ini dibuat oleh Chargé d 'Affaires of the Saudi Permanent Mission kepada PBB di New York Faris Al- Otaibi selama debat terbuka Dewan Keamanan PBB pada resolusi konflik di tengah perubahan teknologi cepat. Al- Otaibi telah menegaskan bahwa penggunaan teknologi kecerdasan buatan harus mematuhi prinsip-prinsip dasar, terutama di antara mereka tanggung jawab manusia. Kerajaan juga menekankan pentingnya transparansi dalam menjelaskan kemampuan, keterbatasan, dan risiko potensial sistem AI, serta kebutuhan untuk menerapkan tindakan pencegahan yang sesuai. Dia mencatat bahwa perkembangan cepat teknologi militer membutuhkan kepatuhan dengan hukum kemanusiaan internasional, perlindungan warga sipil, dan pelestarian pengawasan manusia dan akuntabilitas. Al- Otaibi lebih lanjut menyerukan kerja sama internasional yang lebih kuat, bangunan kapasitas, dan pertukaran keahlian untuk memungkinkan negara-negara untuk memperoleh keuntungan dari teknologi modern sambil memastikan penggunaan aman dan bertanggung jawab mereka.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia sounds alarm at UNSC over terrorist misuse of emerging technologies
articles.originalDescription: NEW YORK — Saudi Arabia warns against the exploitation of emerging technologies by terrorist groups, including components that could be used to develop military capabilities. These remarks were made by Acting Chargé d'Affaires of the Saudi Permanent Mission to the UN in New York Faris Al-Otaibi during an open debate of the UN Security Council on conflict resolution amid rapid technological change. Al-Otaibi has affirmed that the use of artificial intelligence technologies must adhere to fundamental principles, foremost among them human responsibility. The Kingdom also stressed the importance of transparency in explaining the capabilities, limitations, and potential risks of AI systems, as well as the need to implement appropriate precautionary measures.He noted that the rapid development of military technologies necessitates compliance with international humanitarian law, the protection of civilians, and the preservation of human oversight and accountability.Al-Otaibi further called for stronger international cooperation, capacity building, and the exchange of expertise to enable countries to benefit from modern technologies while ensuring their safe and responsible use.

articles.description: Mengapa solidaritas dengan Gaza gagal menghentikan pembantaian yang dilakukan oleh Ghada Magadli di Wed, 11 / 25 / 2026 - 12: 01 Kita perlu berpikir lebih serius tentang bagaimana solidaritas dapat menjadi komitmen politik yang sedang berlangsung daripada reaksi terhadap saat-saat kekerasan Abeer, istri Khaled Naeem, yang terbunuh dalam sebuah serangan Israel, berduka bersama dengan anaknya di Gaza City pada 21 November 2026, pada 12 November, Israel menyerang Nasser Hospital di Khan Younis, membunuh enam orang Palestina dan melukai lebih banyak lagi. Di antara mereka yang tewas adalah Saif Abu Hahib, yang sedang menunggu operasi, dan Dr Rizq Abu Shaeira, seorang ahli bedah yang bekerja di rumah sakit. Ahli bedah lainnya, pasien dan teman-teman mereka yang terluka. Selain pelaporan dan kutukan akrab dari organisasi hak asasi manusia dan agen PBB, serangan itu tampaknya menimbulkan sedikit reaksi, apalagi konsekuensi politik bagi Israel. Tapi apakah ini benar-benar mengejutkan? Setelah Israel secara sistematis menyerang dan membongkar sistem kesehatan Gaza dari tahun 2023 sampai 2025, mengapa serangan lain terhadap surat perintah rumah sakit lainnya merupakan respon yang berbeda? Namun, inilah saat yang tepat untuk mengajukan beberapa pertanyaan serius tentang tatanan politik internasional dan tanggapan terhadap genosida Israel di Gaza. Bagaimana kita mencapai titik di mana serangan terhadap rumah sakit, membunuh pasien dan dokter merawat mereka, dapat melewati hampir tanpa diketahui? Tumbuh ketidakpedulian Tiga tahun dalam genosida, pertumbuhan mati rasa dan ketidakpedulian terhadap Gaza semakin sulit untuk diabaikan. Sejak gencatan senjata terjadi pada Oktober 2025, lebih dari 1.600 warga Palestina dilaporkan tewas dan 5.833 terluka, sementara situasi kemanusiaan tetap menjadi bencana. articles.originalTitle: Why solidarity with Gaza failed to stop the genocide
articles.originalDescription: Why solidarity with Gaza failed to stop the genocide Submitted by Ghada Majadli on Wed, 11/25/2026 - 12:01 We need to think more seriously about how solidarity can become an ongoing political commitment rather than a reaction to particular moments of violence Abeer, the wife of Khaled Naeem, who was killed in an Israeli strike, mourns together with her son and daughter in Gaza City on 21 November 2026 (AFP) Off On 12 November, Israel attacked Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, killing six Palestinians and injuring dozens more. Among those killed were Saif Abu Hatab, who was awaiting surgery, and Dr Rizq Abu Shaeira, a surgeon working at the hospital. Other surgeons, patients and their companions were among the injured. Beyond the reporting and familiar condemnations from human rights organisations and UN agencies, the attack appeared to provoke little reaction, let alone meaningful political consequences for Israel. But is this really surprising? After Israel systematically attacked and dismantled Gaza's healthcare system from 2023 through 2025, why would another attack on another hospital warrant a different response? Still, this is precisely the moment to ask some serious questions about the international political order and its response to Israel's genocide in Gaza . How have we reached a point where an attack on a hospital, killing patients and the doctors treating them, can pass almost unnoticed? Growing indifference Three years into the genocide, the growing numbness and indifference towards Gaza are increasingly difficult to ignore. Since the ceasefire came into effect in October 2025, more than 1,600 Palestinians have reportedly been killed and 5,833 injured, while the humanitarian situation remains catastrophic. articles.description: Perang Yaman: bagaimana aliansi saingan dan faksi bersenjata menumpuk? Sebuah gencatan senjata disepakati di tahun 2022 antara Ansar Allah, lebih dikenal sebagai Houthis, yang mengontrol utara, dan kekuatan setia kepada pemerintah di selatan hancur ketika Arab Saudi dibom bandara Sanaa pada bulan Juli. Pada bulan Agustus dan September, Houthis menyerang dengan cepat, merebut kembali sebagian besar pantai barat, termasuk pelabuhan Mocha, menempatkannya dalam jarak dekat kapal melewati selat Bab penting secara strategis. Houthis sekarang menargetkan Aden, kota kedua Yaman dan kursi pemerintahan internasional yang diakui sejak kelompok mengambil ibukota Sanaa 12 tahun yang lalu. Sementara itu, Houthis telah memperketat pengepungan dekade- panjang Taiz, memblokir jalan ke Aden dan meningkatkan prospek penangkapannya. Saudi- didukung pro-pemerintah koalisi militer berisi berbagai unit bersenjata dan milisi lokal, masing-masing dengan tujuan yang berbeda, saingan pemimpin dan asal-usul, mengarah ke inmemerangi dan diorganisasi. Kesetiaan sering berubah dan berkembang: Brigade Raksasa dan Pasukan Perlawanan Nasional masing-masing didukung oleh UEA. Kedua pemimpin, seperti kebanyakan koalisi, sekarang dibiayai oleh Riyadh di tengah kejatuhan dengan Abu Dhabi. articles.originalTitle: Yemen war: How do the rival alliances and armed factions stack up?
articles.originalDescription: Yemen war: How do the rival alliances and armed factions stack up? Submitted by Daniel Tester on Tue, 11/24/2026 - 15:50 The Saudi-backed government is leading a fragile coalition including the Giants Brigades, Homeland Shield and other military units against the Iran-aligned Houthis A fighter, left, loyal to Yemen's government in western Taiz province; and right, a fighter loyal to the Houthi authorities, in Sanaa (both AFP, October 2026) Off Yemen , where civil war broke out in 2014, has recently been rocked by the worst fighting in years. A truce agreed in 2022 between the Ansar Allah, better known as the Houthis, who control the north, and forces loyal to the government in the south disintegrated when Saudi Arabia bombed Sanaa airport in July. In August and September, the Houthis mounted a quick offensive, recapturing much of the western coast, including the port of Mocha, putting it within close range of ships passing the strategically important Bab el-Mandab strait. The Houthis are now targeting Aden, Yemen’s second city and seat of its internationally recognised government since the group took the capital Sanaa 12 years ago. Meanwhile, the Houthis have tightened their decade-long siege of Taiz, blocking the road to Aden and raising the prospect of its capture. The Saudi-backed pro-government military coalition contains a variety of armed units and local militias, each with different goals, rival leaders and origins, leading to infighting and disorganisation. Allegiances frequently shift and evolve: the Giants Brigade and the National Resistance Forces were each previously backed by the UAE . The leaders of both, like much of the coalition, are now bankrolled by Riyadh amid its fallout with Abu Dhabi.
