articles.description: GCC mengutuk serangan Houthi menargetkan gedung pencakar langit Riyadh, Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi, secrettary- Jenderal Dewan Koperasi Teluk (GCC), telah menghukum dengan keras "serangan berbahaya" yang diluncurkan oleh Houthis-align di sebuah menara di ibukota Saudi, Riyadh 's pusat keuangan. articles.originalTitle: GCC condemns Houthi attack targeting Riyadh skyscraper
articles.originalDescription: GCC condemns Houthi attack targeting Riyadh skyscraper Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi, secretary-general of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), has strongly condemned the “treacherous attack” launched by the Iran-aligned Houthis on a tower in Saudi capital Riyadh’s financial centre. The attack injured 11 people - two Saudi citizens and nine foreign nationals. “This attack is a heinous crime and an aggression that reveals the danger of this militia’s terrorist approach and its disregard for innocent lives, which requires a decisive international stance to hold this militia accountable,” Albudaiwi said in a statement. He added that the GCC member states stand with Saudi Arabia.

articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Culture has introduced a cultural insurance consulting service that enables individuals, government entities, and cultural establishments to identify risks to cultural assets and activities and make informed insurance decisions. articles.title: AI memimpin sektor teknologi registrasi komersial dengan 31% lonjakan
articles.description: RIYADH - Departemen Perdagangan telah melaporkan pertumbuhan signifikan dalam pendaftaran komersial aktif di sektor teknologi menjanjikan pada tahun 2026. Hal ini didorong oleh upaya untuk memfasilitasi transformasi digital dan inovasi, mempromosikan diversifikasi ekonomi, kewirausahaan asuh, dan mendukung tujuan dari Saudi Vision 2030. Pada akhir kuartal ketiga 2026, pendaftaran komersial aktif untuk teknologi kecerdasan buatan naik 31persen ke 24.693, dibandingkan dengan 18,846 dalam periode yang sama pada 2025. Registrasi dalam layanan komputasi awan meningkat 35 persen menjadi 7.362 dari 5.466 setahun sebelumnya. Registrasi komersial aktif di sektor keamanan cyber juga meningkat 22 persen ke 11.274 pada akhir kuartal ketiga 2026, dari 9.238 pada periode yang berhubungan tahun 2025. Registrasi dalam industri game elektronik naik 25 persen ke 981 pada akhir kuartal ketiga 2026, naik dari 784 dalam periode yang sama tahun sebelumnya.
articles.originalTitle: AI leads tech sector commercial registrations with 31% surge
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Commerce has reported significant growth in active commercial registrations in promising technology sectors in 2026. This was driven by efforts to facilitate digital transformation and innovation, promote economic diversification, foster entrepreneurship, and support the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. By the end of the third quarter of 2026, active commercial registrations for artificial intelligence technologies rose 31percent to 24,693, compared with 18,846 in the same period of 2025. Registrations in cloud computing services increased 35 percent to 7,362 from 5,466 a year earlier. Active commercial registrations in the cybersecurity sector also grew 22 percent to 11,274 by the end of the third quarter of 2026, from 9,238 in the corresponding period of 2025. Registrations in the electronic gaming industry climbed 25 percent to 981 by the end of the third quarter of 2026, up from 784 in the same period the previous year.

articles.title: Houthis tidak akan merebut Aden, pasukan pemerintah Yaman mengatakan
articles.description: Houthis tidak akan merebut Aden, pasukan pemerintah Yaman mengatakan Houthis Iran- yang selaras Yaman telah mendorong sedekat 60 km ke Aden, ibukota sementara negara internasional yang diakui pemerintah, tetapi mereka tidak akan menangkap kota, militer Yaman mengatakan pada hari Selasa. "Aku akan berbicara kepada Anda terus terang. Situasi ini bukan tempat yang kita inginkan. Tapi itu tidak mengerikan seperti yang dilaporkan," Kolonel Mamed Abdullah Al- Nuzaily, juru bicara untuk angkatan bersenjata Yaman, mengatakan sekelompok wartawan melalui link video. Sejak pertempuran dilanjutkan di Yaman pada bulan Juli dengan perang Iran yang lebih luas, Houthis telah berkembang pesat di Yaman, merebut wilayah dari pemerintah internasional dan sekutunya yang didukung oleh Arab Saudi. Saudi telah melakukan serangan udara di Yaman untuk mendukung sekutu mereka di darat, sementara Houthis telah menyerang target minyak Saudi, bandara dan menara kantor. Aden, sekarang target serangan rudal dan pesawat tak berawak Houthi, sebelumnya belum pernah melihat permusuhan besar sejak pertempuran jalanan di 2015, segera setelah pemerintah internasional diakui melarikan diri dari Perumahan-run Sanaa dan membuat kota pelabuhan basis tersebut. Pelaporan oleh Reuters
articles.originalTitle: Houthis won't seize Aden, Yemeni government forces say
articles.originalDescription: Houthis won't seize Aden, Yemeni government forces say Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis have pushed as close as 60 km to Aden, the temporary capital of the country's internationally recognised government, but they will not capture the city, Yemen's military said on Tuesday. "I'll speak to you frankly. The situation is not where we want it to be. But it's not as dire as reported," Colonel Majed Abdullah Al-Nuzaily, spokesperson for Yemen's armed forces, told a group of reporters via video link. Since fighting resumed in Yemen in July in parallel with the wider Iran war, the Houthis have rapidly advanced in Yemen, seizing territory from the internationally recognised government and its allies, who are backed by Saudi Arabia. The Saudis have carried out air strikes on Yemen in support of their allies on the ground, while the Houthis have struck Saudi oil targets, airports and office towers. Aden, now the target of Houthi missile and drone strikes, had previously not seen major hostilities since street battles in 2015, soon after the internationally recognised government fled Houthi-run Sanaa and made the port city its base. Reporting by Reuters

articles.originalTitle: Eleven hurt in second Houthi strike within days on Riyadh's tallest tower
articles.originalDescription: Eleven hurt in second Houthi strike within days on Riyadh's tallest tower Yemen's Houthis struck the tallest skyscraper in the Saudi capital Riyadh on Tuesday for the second time in less than a week, wounding at least 11 people. Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence reported the injuries and posted a picture of the landmark tower housing the headquarters of the Saudi Public Investment Fund. The image showed some damage to the building about halfway up the facade, similar to the impact from a strike on the same tower on 19 November, which caused damage but no injuries. The Saudi-led coalition fighting against Yemen's Houthis said a skyscraper in Riyadh's financial district had been targeted by a "terrorist attack" without providing further details.

articles.originalDescription: Riyadh's landmark 'PIF Tower' struck in aerial attack for second time in five days Submitted by MEE staff on Tue, 11/24/2026 - 15:52 The building in Saudi capital houses the offices of the country's sovereign wealth fund, the Public Investment Fund Riyadh's skyline, featuring the PIF tower, on 22 November 2026 (AFP) Off A building housing the headquarters of Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund in Riyadh has been hit for the second time in under a week. Riyadh called Tuesday's suspected drone attack by Yemen's Houthi-aligned forces a "cowardly terrorist attack". Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence reported that 11 people were injured in the strike and posted a picture of the landmark tower housing the headquarters of the Saudi Public Investment Fund (PIF). The PIF Tower was previously hit in an attack last Thursday. It is one of the Saudi capital's tallest buildings and is part of the King Abdullah Financial District. Yemen's Houthis have demonstrated an ability to consistently strike prominent targets within Saudi Arabia, even as Riyadh launches its own air strikes on Yemen. Earlier in November, a building belonging to the kingdom's oil giant Aramco was damaged in an attack in Riyadh. In October, an attack on Riyadh's airport killed at least 14 people. Residents told Saba that badly burnt human remains were still inside one of two buses hit in the attack, hampering identification. They said Saudi warplanes continued circling overhead, blocking ambulance crews and residents from reaching those caught in the strikes and worsening the toll. articles.description: Menteri Keuangan Saudi mengklaim bahwa kerajaan dapat menahan konflik yang berkepanjangan dengan Menteri Keuangan Saudi Mohammed al- Jataan mengatakan kerajaan ini "cukup tangguh untuk bertahan dari konflik yang berkepanjangan" dengan Perumahan Yaman. Berbicara dengan wartawan, juga - Jadan diberhentikan sebagai "kesalahan total" setiap harapan yang menyerang infrastruktur sipil atau "pemerasan oleh rudal" akan memaksa Riyadh untuk berkompromi keamanan nasional. Dia mengatakan Arab Saudi berencana untuk mengurangi defisit anggaran menjadi 3,6 persen PDB pada tahun 2027, dibandingkan dengan 4,9 persen tahun ini, meskipun pertempuran meningkat. Iran- didukung Houthis mengatakan rudal mereka dan kampanye drone bertujuan untuk memaksa Riyadh untuk menarik dukungan untuk pemerintah Yaman. Al- Jataan mengatakan pengurangan produksi minyak telah mendorong 2,1 persen kontraksi di PDB Saudi tahun ini.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi finance minister claims kingdom can withstand prolonged Houthi conflict
articles.originalDescription: Saudi finance minister claims kingdom can withstand prolonged Houthi conflict Saudi Finance Minister Mohammed al-Jadaan says the kingdom is “resilient enough to withstand a prolonged conflict” with Yemen’s Houthis. Speaking to reporters, al-Jadaan dismissed as “a total mistake” any expectation that attacks on civilian infrastructure or “blackmail by missiles” would force Riyadh to compromise its national security. He said Saudi Arabia plans to reduce its budget deficit to 3.6 percent of GDP in 2027, compared with an estimated 4.9 percent this year, despite the escalating fighting. The Iran-backed Houthis say their missile and drone campaign aims to force Riyadh to withdraw support for Yemen’s government. Al-Jadaan said reduced oil production had driven a 2.1 percent contraction in Saudi GDP this year.

articles.title: Departemen Yaman menempatkan kerugian dari serangan Saudi dan blokade di atas $1,13 triliun
articles.description: Kementerian Yemen menanggung kerugian dari serangan Saudi dan memblokade lebih dari 1,13 triliun dolar Departemen Ekonomi Yaman mengatakan serangan Saudi dan blokade tersebut telah mengakibatkan lebih dari $1.13 triliun kerugian ekonomi cumulatif sejak perang dimulai pada Maret 2015. Menteri Ekonomi Sam Bashiri mengatakan perkiraan awal menempatkan kerusakan langsung selama eskalasi terbaru, dari 13 Juli ke 23 November, di lebih dari $881.5m, laporan Saba. Dia bilang Saudi menyerang 22 pabrik dan sebagian rusak tiga lainnya, menyebabkan kerugian industri melebihi $376m. Menteri menempatkan kerugian komersial di atas $85m dan kerugian sektor di atas $20m. Menteri Transportasi dan Pekerjaan Umum Mohammed Quhaim melaporkan kerusakan lebih dari $350m terhadap infrastruktur dan sektor lain selama periode yang sama. Quhaim mengatakan serangan di bandara, pelabuhan, jalan raya dan jembatan telah mengganggu persediaan dan peningkatan pengiriman, asuransi dan biaya penyimpanan, menempatkan lebih lanjut tekanan keuangan pada Yaman. Pengumuman ini tidak memberikan metodologi rinci untuk perkiraan angka tiga juta dolar.
articles.originalTitle: Yemen ministry puts losses from Saudi attacks and blockade above $1.13 trillion
articles.originalDescription: Yemen ministry puts losses from Saudi attacks and blockade above $1.13 trillion Yemen’s Houthi-run Economy Ministry says Saudi attacks and the blockade have inflicted more than $1.13 trillion in cumulative economic losses since the war began began in March 2015. Acting Economy Minister Sam al-Bashiri said preliminary estimates put direct damage during the latest escalation, from 13 July to 23 November, at more than $881.5m, Saba reports. He said Saudi strikes destroyed 22 factories and partially damaged three others, causing industrial losses exceeding $376m. The ministry put commercial losses above $85m and investment-sector losses above $20m. Transport and Public Works Minister Mohammed Quhaim reported more than $350m in damage to infrastructure and other sectors during the same period. Quhaim said attacks on airports, ports, roads and bridges had disrupted supplies and increased shipping, insurance and storage costs, placing further financial pressure on Yemenis. The announcement provided no detailed methodology for the cumulative trillion-dollar estimate.

articles.title: 11 terluka dalam serangan Houthi pada menara distrik keuangan Riyadh

Orang-orang yang terluka termasuk dua warga Saudi, empat warga Mesir, tiga warga Nepal, dan dua warga India, menurut juru bicara Pertahanan Sipil. Juru bicara menyatakan bahwa pihak berwenang menanggapi dengan cepat insiden tersebut, menerapkan semua prosedur darurat yang disetujui dan langkah-langkah dan mengambil setiap langkah yang diperlukan untuk menjaga kehidupan dan properti. Pagi-pagi sekali, Mayor. Jenderal Turki Al- Malaki, juru bicara Koalisi untuk memulihkan Legitimasi di Yaman, mengungkapkan bahwa salah satu menara distrik keuangan di Riyadh telah menjadi target dalam serangan teroris pengecut.

articles.description: RIYADH - Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman menegaskan bahwa anggaran 2027 mencerminkan komitmen pemerintah untuk memajukan pembangunan nasional, menempatkan kepentingan warga negara di jantung prioritas, dan menjaga pembangunan Kerajaan mencapai untuk memastikan keberlanjutan mereka untuk generasi yang akan datang. Dalam pernyataan pasca anggaran setelah persetujuan anggaran umum negara untuk fiskal tahun 2027 oleh Kabinet, Putra Mahkota, yang juga ketua Dewan Ekonomi dan Pengembangan urusan, mencatat bahwa prestasi menyadari sejauh ini adalah hasil dari petunjuk dari Dua Kudus Mosques Raja Salman dan usaha warga negara. Putra Mahkota menyatakan bahwa pekerjaan dalam tahap ketiga dari Saudi Vision 2030 dibangun pada reformasi dan prestasi dicapai selama dua tahap sebelumnya. "Kami memaksimalkan dampak dari visi pada kehidupan masyarakat, mengubah prestasi menjadi kekuatan berkelanjutan bagi perekonomian kita dan kesempatan baru untuk generasi mendatang", katanya. Putra Mahkota menekankan ekspansi terus-menerus kesempatan pembangunan, investasi dalam kemampuan warga Saudi, dan bangunan yang lebih beragam dan kompetitif ekonomi yang dampaknya meluas lebih dari tahun 2030. Putra Mahkota menegaskan bahwa anggaran 2027 adalah bagian dari rencana keuangan jangka panjang yang mendukung pertumbuhan berkelanjutan, menerapkan prioritas pembangunan, dan memperkuat kesinambungan keuangan publik, sementara mempertahankan fleksibel alokasi sumber daya dan terus mendanai program dan proyek dengan dampak ekonomi dan sosial. articles.originalTitle: Crown Prince: 2027 budget transforms Vision 2030 achievements into lasting economic strength
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman underscored that the 2027 budget reflects the government's unwavering commitment to advancing national development, placing citizens' interests at the heart of its priorities, and safeguarding the Kingdom's development achievements to ensure their sustainability for generations to come. In post budgetary remarks after approval of the state’s general budget for the fiscal year 2027 by the Cabinet, the Crown Prince, who is also chairman of the Council of Economic and Development Affairs, noted that the achievements realized so far are the result of the directives of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and the efforts of citizens. The Crown Prince stated that work in the third phase of Saudi Vision 2030 builds upon the reforms and accomplishments achieved during the previous two phases. "We are maximizing the impact of the Vision on people's lives, transforming its achievements into a sustainable strength for our economy and renewed opportunities for future generations,” he said. The Crown Prince emphasized the continued expansion of development opportunities, investment in the capabilities of Saudi citizens, and the building of a more diverse and competitive economy whose impact extends beyond 2030. The Crown Prince affirmed that the 2027 budget is part of a long-term financial plan that balances supporting sustainable growth, implementing development priorities, and strengthening public finance sustainability, while maintaining flexibility in resource allocation and continued funding for programs and projects with economic and social impact. He noted that enhancing the effectiveness of the social support and protection system—by directing spending to those most in need and raising living standards and quality of life—remains a core priority within Saudi Arabia's fiscal and economic policy, alongside continued investment in infrastructure and essential services for citizens, residents, and visitors

articles.title: Inggris mengeluarkan 'nilai-nilai Inggris' dalam sanksi Houthi terbaru, tidak menyebutkan Arab Saudi sekutu
articles.description: Inggris menyebut 'nilai-nilai Inggris' dalam sanksi-sanksi Houthi terbaru, tidak menyebutkan sekutu Arab Saudi Inggris telah memberlakukan sanksi baru di Yaman Houthis, menuduh kelompok "pelanggaran HAM serius" dan upaya untuk "melemahkan" Stabilitas Timur Tengah. Menteri Luar Negeri Ed Miliband menghubungkan langkah-langkah untuk menyerang kapal dagang di Bab al- Mandeb, mengatakan mereka telah "didorong biaya hidup di rumah". Dia mengatakan sanksi mengirim "pesan yang jelas" bahwa Inggris akan "bertindak untuk mendukung nilai-nilai dan kepentingan Inggris," menurut pernyataan pemerintah. "Agresi baru Houthis 'menargetkan mitra kami dan warga sipil tidak bersalah tidak dapat diterima, dan mereka harus diadakan", kata Miliband. Pemerintah Inggris tidak menyebutkan sekutu Arab Saudi, yang membantu dalam peran penasihat dan dengan perangkat keras militer untuk melaksanakan serangan di Yaman yang telah membunuh ratusan warga sipil.
articles.originalTitle: UK invokes ‘British values’ in latest Houthi sanctions, makes no mention of ally Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: UK invokes ‘British values’ in latest Houthi sanctions, makes no mention of ally Saudi Arabia Britain has imposed fresh sanctions on Yemen’s Houthis, accusing the group of “serious human rights abuses” and efforts to “undermine” Middle Eastern stability. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband linked the measures to attacks on merchant vessels in Bab al-Mandeb, saying they had “driven up the cost of living at home”. He said the sanctions sent a “clear message” that Britain would “act in support of British values and interests,” according to a government statement. “The Houthis’ renewed aggression targeting our partners and innocent civilians is unacceptable, and they must be held to account,” said Miliband. The British government made no mention of its ally Saudi Arabia, which it is helping in an advisory role and with military hardware to carry out attacks on Yemen that have killed hundreds of civilians.

articles.title: Kasus genosida Rohingya:
articles.description: Kasus genosida Rohingya: Bagaimana Gambia pergi ke Den Haag dan dimenangkan oleh Sondos Asem on Sun, 11 / 22 / 2026 - 15: 04 Kepala pengacara Arsalan Suleman mengatakan kepada Mata Timur Tengah bagaimana negara Afrika kecil dibawa ke pengadilan Myanmar dan bagaimana kesaksian yang selamat membantu mengamankan penilaian tengara 80 tahun setelah International Court of Justice (ICJ) pertama kali duduk di Den Haag, saya berjalan ke Istana Perdamaian Great Justice untuk memotret para hakim saat mereka duduk. Mereka akan memberikan penilaian penting dalam kasus trailbling yang dibawa oleh Gambia melawan Myanmar. Untuk pertama kalinya, pengadilan akan menemukan bahwa negara telah melakukan genosida, "kejahatan" seperti yang telah digambarkan. Sudah tujuh tahun sejak Gambia, secuil negara kurang dari tiga juta orang di Afrika Barat yang bernama setelah sungai yang membedah itu, mengajukan kasus ini. Hal ini berpendapat bahwa Myanmar mencoba untuk menghancurkan Rohingya, minoritas mayoritas Muslim yang telah tinggal di Rakhine State pada negara bagian barat untuk generasi. Kasus ini dibawa ke bawah Konvensi Genosida tahun 1948, PBB pertama perjanjian hak asasi manusia, disusun setelah Holocaust untuk mendefinisikan genosida di bawah hukum internasional dan membutuhkan negara untuk mencegah dan menghukumnya. Di masa lalu, pengadilan kriminal internasional telah menghukum individu-individu genosida, seperti di pengadilan diciptakan untuk menuntut kekejaman yang dilakukan selama perang di Yugoslavia dan di Rwanda pada tahun 1990-an. Namun kali ini, pertanyaan sebelum ICJ, Pengadilan Tertinggi PBB yang terutama menyatakan perselisihan antar negara, adalah apakah Myanmar sendiri, sebagai aktor negara, dapat bertanggung jawab. Pada tahun 2017, militer Myanmar membakar desa Rohingya, melakukan pembunuhan massal dan pemerkosaan yang meluas, dan sengaja membunuh anak-anak, yang ditemukan oleh pengadilan. articles.originalTitle: Rohingya genocide case: How The Gambia went to The Hague and won
articles.originalDescription: Rohingya genocide case: How The Gambia went to The Hague and won Submitted by Sondos Asem on Sun, 11/22/2026 - 15:04 Lead counsel Arsalan Suleman tells Middle East Eye how the small African country took Myanmar to court and how survivor testimony helped secure a landmark judgement Eighty years after the International Court of Justice (ICJ) first sat in The Hague, I walked into the Peace Palace’s Great Hall of Justice to photograph the judges as they took their seats. They were about to deliver a landmark judgment in a trailblazing case brought by The Gambia against Myanmar. For the first time, the court would find that a state had committed genocide, the " crime of all crimes " as it has been described. It had been seven years since The Gambia, a slither of a country of less than three million people in West Africa that is named after the river that dissects it, filed the case. It argued that Myanmar was trying to destroy the Rohingya, a predominantly Muslim minority that has lived in Rakhine State on the country's western coast for generations. The case was brought under the 1948 Genocide Convention , the UN’s first human rights treaty, drawn up in the wake of the Holocaust to define genocide under international law and require states to prevent and punish it. In the past, international criminal tribunals have convicted individuals of genocide, such as in courts created to prosecute atrocities committed during the wars in the former Yugoslavia and in Rwanda in the 1990s. But this time the question before the ICJ, the UN’s highest court which adjudicates mainly in disputes between states, was whether Myanmar itself, as a state actor, can be held responsible. In 2017, Myanmar’s military burned Rohingya villages , carried out mass killings and widespread rape, and deliberately killed children, the court found. articles.title: Arab Saudi mengungkap 2027 anggaran negara dengan SR1.201 triliun pendapatan dan SR1.392 triliun pengeluaran
articles.description: RIYADH - Dewan Menteri Saudi, dipimpin oleh Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman di Riyadh pada hari Selasa, telah menyetujui anggaran umum negara untuk tahun fiskal 2027. Anggaran memperkirakan SR1.201 triliun pendapatan dan SR1.392 triliun pengeluaran, dengan defisit diproyeksikan dari SR190.56 miliar. Putra Mahkota mengarahkan menteri dan pejabat, masing-masing dalam area tanggung jawab masing-masing, untuk menggandakan komitmen mereka untuk melaksanakan pengembangan anggaran dan program sosial dan proyek, dan untuk memobilisasi semua sumber daya nasional dan kemampuan untuk memajukan negara dan menjaga kepentingan warganya. Putra Mahkota menyoroti ketahanan ekonomi Saudi pada tahun 2026, yang ditahan oleh dasar-dasar yang kuat, kebijakan fiskal yang fleksibel, pendekatan yang tampak maju untuk perencanaan jangka panjang, dan investasi berkualitas tinggi yang meningkatkan persiapan infrastruktur dan memperkuat ekosistem logistik. Faktor-faktor ini telah memungkinkan Kerajaan untuk mempertahankan pembangunan drive sambil efektif menavigasi berbagai krisis dan tantangan, ia menekankan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia unveils 2027 state budget with SR1.201 trillion revenues and SR1.392 trillion expenditures
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Saudi Council of Ministers, chaired by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman in Riyadh on Tuesday, has approved the state’s general budget for the fiscal year 2027. The budget estimates SR1.201 trillion revenues and SR1.392 trillion expenditures, with a projected deficit of SR190.56 billion. The Crown Prince directed ministers and officials, each within their respective areas of responsibility, to redouble their commitment to implementing the budget’s development and social programs and projects, and to mobilize all national resources and capabilities to advance the nation and safeguard the interests of its citizens.The Crown Prince highlighted the Saudi economy’s resilience throughout 2026, underpinned by strong fundamentals, flexible fiscal policies, a forward-looking approach to long-term planning, and high-quality investments that enhanced infrastructure preparedness and strengthened the logistics ecosystem. These factors have enabled the Kingdom to sustain its development drive while effectively navigating various crises and challenges, he emphasized.

articles.title: Saudi- Omani kerjasama foils keamanan penyelundupan 500.000 pil narkotika
articles.description: RIYADH - Saudi- Omani kerjasama keamanan telah berperan dalam upaya foiling menyelundupkan 500.000 pil narkotika. Kementerian Keamanan Dalam Negeri Brigt. Talal bin Shalhoub menyatakan bahwa informasi yang disediakan oleh kementrian melalui Direktorat Umum Kontrol Narkotik ke rekan-rekannya di Oman memungkinkan pihak berwenang di sana untuk menggagalkan upaya penyelundupan. Langkah ini mengikuti pemantauan proaktif jaringan kriminal yang terlibat dalam penyelundupan narkoba, katanya. Juru bicara menyoroti kerjasama yang sedang berlangsung dengan pihak berwenang di Oman mengenai pelacakan dan penyitaan narkotika. Dia menekankan bahwa kolaborasi ini mencerminkan tingkat integrasi yang tinggi dan koordinasi keamanan antara dua negara dalam menghadapi jaringan kriminal trannasional. Dia lebih lanjut menegaskan bahwa Kerajaan tetap berkomitmen untuk memantau kegiatan kriminal yang menargetkan keamanan dan masa mudanya melalui obat-obatan sebagai bagian dari upaya untuk melindungi masyarakat dari momok narkotika.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi-Omani security cooperation foils smuggling of 500,000 narcotic pills
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi-Omani security cooperation has been instrumental in foiling attempt to smuggle 500,000 narcotic pills. Ministry of Interior Security Spokesperson Brig. Gen. Talal bin Shalhoub stated that information provided by the ministry through the General Directorate of Narcotics Control to its counterpart in Oman enabled the authorities there to thwart the smuggling attempt. This move follows proactive monitoring of criminal networks involved in drug smuggling, he said. The spokesperson highlighted the ongoing cooperation with the authorities in Oman regarding the tracking and seizure of narcotics. He emphasized that this collaboration reflects the high level of integration and security coordination between the two countries in confronting transnational criminal networks. He further affirmed that the Kingdom remains committed to monitoring criminal activities that target its security and its youth through drugs as part of efforts to protect society from the scourge of narcotics.

articles.description: ALULA - Komisi Kerajaan untuk AlUla (RCU), dalam koordinasi dengan National Centre for Wildlife, diumumkan pada hari Selasa pendaftaran resmi Harrat Al Rass Al Abyad Nature Reserve di kedua Database Nasional Areas Protected dan Basis Data Dunia pada Area Perlindungan (WDPA). Terletak di Khaybar Gubernur di wilayah Madinah, pendaftaran cadangan menandai tonggak signifikan dalam upaya untuk melestarikan keanekaragaman hayati yang khas dan formasi geologi langka. Menutupi area 600 kilometer persegi, Harrat Al Rass Al Abyad adalah cadangan keenam dalam jaringan area dilindungi RCU (APAN), yang meliputi total 12.107 kilometer persegi. Pendaftaran ini mencerminkan upaya berkelanjutan RCU untuk memperluas jaringan areanya yang dilindungi, mendokumentasikan aset alaminya dan memperkuat manajemen mereka melalui pendekatan ilmiah yang mendukung kelanjutan jangka panjang. Cadangan ini terletak di dalam Harrat Khaybar, salah satu yang terbesar gunung berapi bidang di Semenanjung Arab, di mana gunung berapi putih berdiri di samping ladang garam hitam, menciptakan pemandangan geologi yang khas. Formasi putih menghasilkan warna khas mereka dari batu vulkanik yang sama, pengaturan mereka terpisah dari lanskap sekitarnya. Harrat Khaybar adalah rumah bagi tiga gunung berapi putih langka - Jabal Al Bayda, Jabal Al Abyad dan Jabal Al Mansaf - menyoroti makna ilmiah daerah dalam mempelajari keragaman geologi dan sejarah aktivitas vulkanik. articles.originalDescription: ALULA — The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU), in coordination with the National Centre for Wildlife, announced on Tuesday the official registration of Harrat Al Rass Al marks a significant milestone in efforts to conserve its distinctive biodiversity and rare geological formations.Covering an area of 600 square kilometers, Harrat Al Rass Al Abyad is the sixth reserve within RCU's protected area network (APAN), which spans a total of 12,107 square kilometers.The registration reflects RCU's continued efforts to expand its protected area network, document its natural assets and strengthen their management through scientific approaches that support long-term sustainability.The reserve is situated within Harrat Khaybar, one of the largest volcanic fields in the Arabian Peninsula, where white volcanoes stand alongside black basalt fields, creating a distinctive geological landscape.The white formations derive their distinctive color from comendite volcanic rocks, setting them apart from the surrounding landscape.Harrat Khaybar is home to three rare white volcanoes — Jabal Al Bayda, Jabal Al Abyad and Jabal Al Mansaf — highlighting the area's scientific significance in studying geological diversity and the history of volcanic activity.The reserve falls under Category III of the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) protected area management categories, which focuses on protecting natural features and their associated biodiversity and habitats.It is also home to Umm Jirsan Cave, one of Saudi Arabia's longest lava tube systems, articles.originalTitle: Egypt's terror list targeting European Muslims echoes Israel and the UAE
articles.originalDescription: Egypt's terror list targeting European Muslims echoes Israel and the UAE Submitted by Farid Hafez on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 17:26 Cairo has designated 35 Muslim associations across Europe as terrorists, months after an Israeli ministry report singled out many of the same names Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi (left) speaks with Luxembourg Prime Minister Luc Frieden (right) and European Council President Antonio Costa at a dinner in Brussels after the EU-Egypt summit on 22 October 2025 (Simon Wohlfahrt/Pool/AFP) Off In September, Egyptian police arrested all six journalists at Matsadaash, a news platform dedicated to fact-checking and investigative reporting. They were accused of spreading misinformation on behalf of the outlawed Muslim Brotherhood, a charge the outlet denies. The authorities then turned on Mada Masr, one of Egypt's best-known independent news sites . In October, a court ordered the site closed. The following month, its editor-in-chief, Lina Attalah, faced a retrial on charges of publishing false news and running an unlicensed website. The same charges brought her a one-year prison sentence in absentia in 2024. Shaher Ayyad, an editorial board member at the news site al-Manassa, told Reuters : "Independent outlets are often portrayed as lawbreakers or enemies of the state." Both cases are part of the repression that Amnesty International detailed in its 2025 report , which found that authorities "continued to criminalize dissenting forms of expression and peaceful assembly, targeting journalists, protesters, opposition politicians and others who criticized the government's human rights record or called for political change". Egypt's record of abuse at home has long been documented. A decade after the former military chief took power , the US State Department's 2024 human rights report called the situation dire. Ulasan ini berlangsung setiap lima tahun dan bertujuan untuk bernegosiasi secara hukum mengikat perjanjian internasional untuk membatasi sistem senjata otonom, di tengah kekhawatiran tumbuh atas penggunaan mereka terhadap warga sipil. Namun, negara militer kuat seperti AS dan Rusia umumnya memblokir kemajuan. Sejak ulasan terakhir, penggunaan senjata bertenaga AI- telah dipercepat secara eksponensial, dengan banyak teknologi mutakhir yang digunakan oleh Israel melawan Palestina di Gaza dan diduduki Bank Barat oleh Israel. Meskipun demikian, Palestina hampir tidak disebutkan selama pertemuan PBB. Minggu lalu, organisasi hak cipta digital Palestina 7amleh mengatur sebuah konferensi di Brussels, dihadiri oleh Mata Timur Tengah, mengumpulkan para pembuat kebijakan, jurnalis, politisi, dan peneliti untuk menilai penggunaan senjata otonom dalam konteks genosida yang sedang berlangsung di Gaza. articles.originalTitle: How EU failure to regulate tech made Palestine a ‘laboratory’ for AI weaponry and surveillance
articles.originalDescription: How EU failure to regulate tech made Palestine a ‘laboratory’ for AI weaponry and surveillance This week, the Geneva Convention held its Seventh Review Conference on the development of technological warfare and its humanitarian implications. The review takes place every five years and aims to negotiate legally binding international agreements on restricting autonomous weapon systems, amid growing concerns over their use against civilians. However, powerful militarised countries like the US and Russia generally block progress. Since the last review, the use of AI-powered weapons has accelerated exponentially, with much of the cutting-edge technology being used by Israelis against Palestinians in Gaza and the occupied West Bank by Israel . Despite this, Palestine was barely mentioned during the UN meeting . Last week, the Palestinian digital rights organisation 7amleh organised a conference in Brussels, attended by Middle East Eye, bringing together policymakers, journalists, politicians and researchers to assess the use of autonomous weapons in the context of the ongoing genocide in Gaza. Read more: How EU failure to regulate tech made Palestine a ‘laboratory’ for AI weaponry and surveillance

articles.title: Raja Salman memerintahkan dukungan upah untuk karyawan Saudi dalam pendirian yang memenuhi syarat sampai tiga bulan
articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga dari Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman telah mengeluarkan perintah kerajaan untuk mendukung upah karyawan Saudi yang bekerja di perusahaan yang memenuhi syarat yang dilindungi oleh Undang-undang Asuransi Sosial melalui skema asuransi pengangguran (DIJUAL) untuk jangka waktu tidak melebihi tiga bulan. Perintah kerajaan, diberikan atas proposal yang diajukan oleh Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman, bertujuan untuk melindungi pekerjaan bagi warga negara Saudi, meningkatkan stabilitas pekerjaan dan memperkuat ketahanan ekonomi nasional. Di bawah perintah kerajaan, karyawan Saudi yang bekerja di bidang yang memenuhi syarat akan dibebaskan dari ketentuan Pasal 8, 10, dan 14 dari Undang-undang Asuransi Penghinaan, serta Pasal 45 dan 46 dari Hukum Asuransi Sosial. Exceptions akan memungkinkan Organisasi Umum untuk Asuransi Sosial (GOSI) untuk membongkar kompensasi yang memenuhi syarat untuk karyawan Saudi dalam kualifikasi perusahaan melalui SANED selama tiga bulan. Perintah kerajaan juga menyediakan pembentukan sebuah komite menteri terdiri dari menteri keuangan, ekonomi, dan perencanaan, dan sumber daya manusia dan pengembangan sosial, serta Gubernur GOSI dan, di mana diperlukan, menteri bertanggung jawab untuk sektor yang dimiliki oleh lembaga yang memenuhi syarat. Komite akan mengidentifikasi sektor yang memenuhi syarat dan pendirian, menetapkan peraturan dan kriteria eligibilitas, dan menentukan mekanisme pembayaran kompensasi dan prioritas untuk memastikan bahwa dukungan mencapai penerima. Kerajaan mencerminkan komitmen kepemimpinan Saudi untuk mempertahankan peluang kerja, meningkatkan stabilitas pekerjaan untuk warga dan memperkuat ekonomi nasional di tengah perkembangan ekonomi regional dan global. Memperkuat ketahanan pasar tenaga kerja Menteri Keuangan dan Ketua Gosi Dewan Direksi Mohammed Aldanah menyatakan rasa terima kasihnya dan apresiasi kepada Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota Mohammed bin Salman untuk kerajaan. articles.originalTitle: King Salman orders wage support for Saudi employees in eligible establishments for up to three months
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman has issued a royal order to support the wages of Saudi employees working in eligible establishments covered by the Social Insurance Law through the unemployment insurance scheme (SANED) for a period not exceeding three months.The royal order, issued upon a proposal submitted by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman, aims to safeguard jobs for Saudi citizens, enhance employment stability and strengthen the resilience of the national economy.Under the royal order, Saudi employees working in eligible establishments will be exempted from the provisions of Articles 8, 10 and 14 of the Unemployment Insurance Law, as well as Articles 45 and 46 of the Social Insurance Law.The exemptions will enable the General Organization for Social Insurance (GOSI) to disburse eligible compensation to Saudi employees in qualifying establishments through SANED for up to three months.The royal order also provides for the formation of a ministerial committee comprising the ministers of finance, economy and planning, and human resources and social development, as well as the GOSI governor and, where necessary, the minister responsible for the sector to which the eligible establishment belongs.The committee will identify eligible sectors and establishments, establish regulations and eligibility criteria, and determine compensation payment mechanisms and priorities to ensure that support reaches intended beneficiaries.The royal order reflects the Saudi leadership's commitment to preserving employment opportunities, enhancing job stability for citizens and strengthening the national economy amid regional and global economic developments. articles.title: Periode rahmat untuk mengatur status GCC-terdaftar kendaraan berakhir
articles.description: RIYADH - Masa kasih karunia 90 hari untuk kendaraan yang terdaftar di Dewan Kerja Teluk (GCC) negara-negara dan hadir di Kerajaan untuk mengatur status mereka berakhir pada hari Senin. Masa kasih telah diberikan oleh Otoritas Pajak, Pajak dan Bea Cukai dalam kerjasama dengan Kementerian Dalam Negeri, diwakili oleh Direktorat Umum Lalu Lintas. Lari dari 26 Agustus ke 23 November, periode rahmat memungkinkan pemilik kendaraan untuk mengatur status mereka baik dengan mengekspor kendaraan mereka dari Kingdom atau menyelesaikan prosedur pendaftaran dan mendapatkan plat nomor Saudi. Berdasarkan peraturan, kendaraan GCC milik warga Saudi atau warga non-GCC, serta kendaraan yang dikendarai oleh individu yang berwenang untuk melakukannya, mungkin tetap berada di Kerajaan ini selama tidak lebih dari 90 hari, apakah berturut-turut, dalam periode 365 hari. Periode dihitung dari tanggal mobil memasuki Kingdom melalui pelabuhan bea cukai. Pihak berwenang menjelaskan bahwa pemilik kendaraan dapat mengatur status mereka baik dengan mengekspor kendaraan mereka dari Kingdom atau mendaftarkan mereka dan mendapatkan plat nomor Saudi. Prosedur ini dapat diselesaikan dengan otorisasi broker pabean untuk mengajukan deklarasi pabean melalui pelabuhan entri terdekat, memenuhi persyaratan yang relevan, dan membayar biaya yang berlaku dan pajak, tanpa harus kembali ke pelabuhan entri asli. Otoritas juga memperkenalkan layanan melalui platform Absher, dalam koordinasi dengan Direktorat Umum Lalu Lintas, memungkinkan pemilik kendaraan untuk meminta perpanjangan kendaraan mereka 'tinggal untuk sampai 30 hari tambahan, asalkan permintaan diajukan sebelum habis habis periode yang sah.
articles.originalTitle: Grace period to regularize status of GCC-registered vehicles expires
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The 90-day grace period for vehicles registered in Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries and present in the Kingdom to regularize their status expired on Monday. The grace period was granted by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority in cooperation with the Ministry of Interior, represented by the General Directorate of Traffic. Running from August 26 to November 23, the grace period allowed vehicle owners to regularize their status either by exporting their vehicles from the Kingdom or completing the registration procedures and obtaining Saudi license plates. Under the regulations, GCC vehicles owned by Saudi citizens or non-GCC residents, as well as vehicles driven by individuals authorized to do so, may remain in the Kingdom for no more than 90 days, whether consecutive or non-consecutive, within any 365-day period. The period is calculated from the date the vehicle enters the Kingdom through a customs port. The authority clarified that vehicle owners can regularize their status either by exporting their vehicles from the Kingdom or registering them and obtaining Saudi license plates. The procedures can be completed by authorizing a customs broker to submit the customs declaration through the nearest port of entry, fulfil the relevant requirements, and pay the applicable fees and taxes, without having to return to the original port of entry. The authority also introduced a service through the Absher platform, in coordination with the General Directorate of Traffic, allowing vehicle owners to request an extension of their vehicles' stay for up to 30 additional days, provided the request is submitted before the expiry of the legally permitted period.

articles.title: Departemen Kesehatan mengambil tindakan hukum terhadap cuti sakit pelanggar
articles.description: RIYADH - Departemen Kesehatan telah mengambil tindakan hukum terhadap pelanggar peraturan cuti sakit. Sebagai bagian dari kampanye inspeksi, petugas pelayanan melakukan 1.817 kunjungan di daerah Arab Saudi. Menggunakan metodologi pemantauan yang canggih, kampanye mengidentifikasi 1116,131 sertifikat cuti sakit yang membutuhkan verifikasi penerbitan hukum mereka. Proses pemantauan mengungkapkan beberapa pola yang membantu mengidentifikasi pelanggaran potensial, paling utama menerbitkan 70,753 sakit meninggalkan sertifikat oleh satu fasilitas kesehatan dan 9.584 oleh seorang praktisi kesehatan tunggal. Ini juga terdeteksi 259 sertifikat dikeluarkan oleh satu praktisi dalam satu hari dan 46,279 sertifikat terkait dengan fasilitas kesehatan yang tidak lengkap. Tim penyelidik kemudian memulai prosedur verifikasi situs dan mengambil langkah yang diperlukan. Kampanye ini mengakibatkan tindakan hukum terhadap pelanggar, termasuk individu yang berusaha untuk memperoleh sejumlah sakit yang tidak sah meninggalkan sertifikat atau sertifikat dari sumber tanpa izin, serta entitas yang gagal mematuhi peraturan. Pengukuran termasuk menangguhkan investigasi yang relevan dan merujuk kasus kepada pihak berwenang yang kompeten. Kampanye ini merupakan bagian dari upaya pelayanan untuk memperkuat kepatuhan dengan peraturan, memastikan keandalan sertifikat cuti sakit, dan melindungi hak-hak penerima '. Kementerian menegaskan kembali komitmennya untuk melindungi hak-hak penerima dan menekankan pentingnya profesionalisme di antara praktisi kesehatan dan keikutsertaan ketat terhadap instruksi yang berlaku, peraturan, dan kontrol.
articles.originalTitle: Health ministry takes legal action against sick leave violators
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Health has taken legal action against violators of its sick leave regulations. As part of its inspection campaign, the ministry officials carried out 1,817 visits across regions of Saudi Arabia. Using an advanced monitoring methodology, the campaign identified 116,131 sick leave certificates requiring verification of their lawful issuance. The monitoring process revealed several patterns that helped identify potential violations, most notably the issuance of 70,753 sick leave certificates by a single healthcare facility and 9,584 by a single healthcare practitioner. It also detected 259 certificates issued by one practitioner in a single day and 46,279 certificates linked to noncompliant healthcare facilities. Inspection teams subsequently initiated on-site verification procedures and took the necessary measures.The campaign resulted in legal action against violators, including individuals who sought to obtain an unauthorized number of sick leave certificates or certificates from unlicensed sources, as well as entities that failed to comply with regulations. Measures included suspending relevant authorizations and referring cases to the competent authorities.The campaign was part of the ministry’s efforts to strengthen compliance with regulations, ensure the reliability of sick leave certificates, and protect beneficiaries' rights. The ministry reaffirmed its commitment to protecting beneficiaries' rights and emphasized the importance of professionalism among healthcare practitioners and strict adherence to applicable instructions, regulations, and controls.

articles.title: KFSH menghormati 41 peneliti bernama diantara 2% ilmuwan terbaik di dunia oleh Stanford
articles.description: RIYADH - Raja Spesialis Faisal & Pusat Penelitian (KFSH) dihormati pada hari Senin 41 ilmuwan dan peneliti setelah mereka dinamai 2% ilmuwan terkemuka di Universitas Stanford. Angka ini menunjukkan peningkatan dari enam peneliti dibandingkan tahun lalu dan menandai tahun ketujuh berturut-turut bahwa peneliti KFSH telah muncul dalam daftar bergengsi, merefleksikan rumah sakit yang tumbuh kontribusi untuk penelitian ilmiah internasional. Tingkat ilmuwan Stanford mengevaluasi menggunakan sejumlah indikator berbasis kota yang mengukur dampak dari karya ilmiah mereka, baik sepanjang karir mereka dan dalam satu tahun. Indikator ini menyediakan wawasan ke dalam pengaruh publikasi peneliti 'dan kontribusi mereka untuk memajukan pengetahuan ilmiah di berbagai disiplin ilmu. Pengakuan datang saat KFSH terus memperkuat posisinya dalam ranking penelitian internasional. Rumah sakit peringkat pertama di antara lembaga kesehatan di Arab Saudi di Indeks Alam 2025, yang melacak penelitian ilmiah diterbitkan pada 145 terkemuka jurnal di seluruh ilmu alam dan kesehatan. Jurnal yang termasuk dalam indeks dipilih oleh panel independen peneliti dan ahli berdasarkan reputasi ilmiah mereka dan dampak. KFSH juga peringkat pertama di Timur Tengah dan Afrika dan 12 di seluruh dunia 250 pusat medis akademis terbaik di 2026. Sebagai tambahan, Brand Finance bernama KFSH adalah merek kesehatan paling berharga di Arab Saudi dan Timur Tengah pada tahun 2026. Rumah sakit juga termasuk di dalam Newsweek' s Best Hospital 2026, serta Rumah Sakit Cerdas Terbaik Dunia 2027 dan Rumah Sakit Terbaik Dunia 2027.
articles.originalTitle: KFSH honors 41 researchers named among world’s top 2% scientists by Stanford
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre (KFSH) honored on Monday 41 of its scientists and researchers after they were named among the world’s top 2 percent most-cited scientists in Stanford University’s annual ranking. The number represents an increase of six researchers compared with last year and marks the seventh consecutive year that KFSH researchers have appeared on the prestigious list, reflecting the hospital’s growing contribution to international scientific research. Stanford’s ranking evaluates researchers using a range of citation-based indicators that measure the impact of their scientific work, both throughout their careers and within a single year. These indicators provide insights into the influence of researchers’ publications and their contributions to advancing scientific knowledge across various disciplines. The recognition comes as KFSH continues to strengthen its position in international research rankings. The hospital ranked first among healthcare institutions in Saudi Arabia in the 2025 Nature Index, which tracks scientific research published in 145 leading journals across the natural and health sciences. The journals included in the index are selected by an independent panel of researchers and experts based on their scientific reputation and impact. KFSH also ranked first in the Middle East and Africa and 12th globally among the world’s top 250 academic medical centers for 2026. In addition, Brand Finance named KFSH the most valuable healthcare brand in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East for 2026. The hospital was also included in Newsweek’s World’s Best Hospitals 2026 ranking, as well as its World’s Best Smart Hospitals 2027 and World’s Best Specialized Hospitals 2027 rankings.

articles.description: RIYADH - Departemen Kesehatan Saudi telah membantah laporan yang mengklaim pembatalan layanan "Wasfini" (resep saya), menegaskan bahwa layanan tersebut tetap beroperasi dan terus menjalani pengembangan dan ekspansi. Menteri menekankan bahwa laporan yang beredar tentang pembatalan layanan tidak akurat. Menteri menekankan komitmennya untuk mengembangkan dan mengembangkannya untuk meningkatkan kualitas kesehatan dan meningkatkan pengalaman pengguna. Dalam pernyataan pada akun X-nya, juru bicara Kementerian Kesehatan Abdulaziz Abdulbaqi mengatakan bahwa "Wasfini" adalah salah satu layanan khusus di bawah Program Transformasi Sektor Kesehatan. Dia mencatat bahwa layanan ini membantu memfasilitasi akses pengobatan dan meningkatkan efisiensi layanan kesehatan. Perlu dicatat bahwa Wasfai adalah layanan resep elektronik yang diawasi oleh Departemen Kesehatan dan dikelola oleh Perusahaan Pemasyarakatan Nasional (NUPCO) yang menghubungkan rumah sakit dan pusat kesehatan primer dengan apotek yang terakreditasi sehingga pasien yang memenuhi syarat dapat menerima pengobatan secara gratis.
articles.originalTitle: Health ministry dismisses Wasfati service cancellation rumors
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Saudi Ministry of Health has denied reports claiming the cancellation of the “Wasfati” (my prescription) service, affirming that the service remains operational and continues to undergo development and expansion. The ministry stressed that reports circulating about the cancellation of the service are inaccurate. The ministry emphasized its commitment to further developing and expanding it to enhance healthcare quality and improve the user experience.In a statement on his X account, Ministry of Health spokesperson Abdulaziz Abdulbaqi said that “Wasfati” is one of the specialized services under the Health Sector Transformation Program. He noted that the service helps facilitate access to medications and enhance the efficiency of healthcare services.It is noteworthy that Wasfati is an electronic prescription service supervised by the Ministry of Health and managed by National Unified Procurement Company (NUPCO) that connects hospitals and primary health care centers with accredited community pharmacies so eligible patients can receive prescribed medications for free.

articles.title: Jumlah jet tempur Rafale India berkurang tiga setelah 2025 pertempuran udara dengan Pakistan
articles.description: jumlah jet tempur Rafale India berkurang tiga setelah 2025 pertempuran udara dengan Pakistan Dipersembahkan oleh staf MEE pada Mon, 11 / 23 / 2026 - 13: 01 Terbukti oleh Angkatan Udara Dunia meningkatkan pengawasan dari penolakan kerugian India terhadap konflik dengan Pakistan pada tahun 2025 pilot naik ke jet tempur Rafale sebelum latihan militer Prancis-India di Mont-Marsan pangkalan udara, Prancis barat daya, 26 November 2025 (Christohe Archabault / AFP). Mati Jumlah jet tempur Rafale aktif di Angkatan Udara India telah jatuh ke 32 dari 35 dalam edisi terbaru dari direktori penerbangan militer internasional, yang telah diaduk pengawasan terbaru India Mei 2025 militer konfrontasi dengan Pakistan. Angka yang direvisi, yang muncul di direktori Angkatan Udara Dunia 2027 yang diterbitkan oleh majalah penerbangan Inggris FlightGlobal, telah memperbarui pertanyaan tentang sejauh kerugian India selama Operasi Sindoor. Setelah 22 April 2025 Pahalgam serangan di Indian- diberikan Kashmir, India meluncurkan kampanye militer pada 7 Mei dan menyerang beberapa target jauh di dalam Pakistan. Dalam keterlibatan jet terbesar abad ke-21, lebih dari 114 pesawat tempur dimobilisasi dan terlibat melintasi perbatasan. Beberapa 72 Angkatan Udara India (IAF) pesawat dan 42 Pakistan Angkatan Udara (PAF) terlibat satu sama lain dalam konfrontasi yang berlangsung sekitar 50 menit, menurut pengarahan militer dan analisis pertahanan. Pakistan mengaku telah menembak jatuh enam pesawat militer India, termasuk tiga Rapales, selama konfrontasi. New Delhi membantah skala klaim Islamabad tapi tidak menerbitkan rekening rinci kerugian pesawat sendiri. Selama briefing militer pada 11 Mei, Marshal Udara Awadhesh Kumar Bharti mengakui bahwa India telah menderita kerugian pesawat tapi menolak untuk mengidentifikasi jumlah atau jenis yang terlibat. "Kami berada dalam skenario pertempuran dan kerugian adalah bagian dari pertempuran", kata Bharti. India Rahul Gandhi kembali melanjutkan perdagangan senjata
articles.originalTitle: India's Rafale fighter jet count reduced by three after 2025 aerial battles with Pakistan
articles.originalDescription: India's Rafale fighter jet count reduced by three after 2025 aerial battles with Pakistan Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/23/2026 - 13:01 Listing by World Air Forces increases scrutiny of India's denial of losses in conflict with Pakistan in 2025 A pilot climbs into a Rafale fighter jet before a French-Indian military exercise at Mont-de-Marsan air base, southwestern France, 26 November 2025 (Christophe Archambault/AFP). Off The number of active Rafale fighter jets in the Indian Air Force has fallen to 32 from 35 in the latest edition of an international military aviation directory, which has stirred renewed scrutiny of India's May 2025 military confrontation with Pakistan. The revised figures, which appear in the 2027 World Air Forces directory published by British aviation magazine FlightGlobal, have renewed questions about the extent of Indian losses during Operation Sindoor. Following the 22 April 2025 Pahalgam attack in Indian-administered Kashmir, India launched the military campaign on 7 May and attacked several targets deep inside Pakistan. In the largest jet engagements of the 21st century, over 114 fighter jets were mobilised and engaged across the border. Some 72 Indian Air Force (IAF) aircraft and 42 Pakistan Air Force (PAF) aircraft engaged each other in a confrontation that lasted roughly 50 minutes, according to military briefings and defence analyses. Pakistan claimed to have shot down six Indian military aircraft, including three Rafales, during the confrontation. New Delhi disputed the scale of Islamabad's claims but did not publish a detailed account of its own aircraft losses. During a military briefing on 11 May, Air Marshal Awadhesh Kumar Bharti acknowledged that India had suffered aircraft losses but declined to identify the number or types involved. “We are in a combat scenario and losses are a part of combat,” Bharti said. articles.title: Israel mungkin akan kehilangan kasus genosida Gaza jika ICJ mengikuti pemerintahan Myanmar, sarjana Tel Aviv mengatakan
articles.description: Israel mungkin kehilangan kasus genosida Gaza jika ICJ mengikuti putusan Myanmar, sarjana Tel Aviv mengatakan Dipersembahkan oleh staf MEE pada Mon, 11 / 23 / 2026 - 14: 00 Profesor Hukum Israel Eliav Liebich mengatakan bahasa yang digunakan oleh pejabat Myanmar dengan ringan dibandingkan dengan Netanyahu, Ben Gvir dan lainnya Perdana Menteri Caretaker Benjamin Netanyahu melihat pada pidato di Knesset Israel pada hari pembukaan parlemen baru di Yerusalem pada tanggal 10 November 2026 (Pengadilan Internasional) "Ini sangat buruk bahwa kita telah mencapai titik ini. Ini adalah gempa bumi yang nyata," kata Eliav Liebich, seorang profesor di Tel Aviv University fakultas hukum. "Sebelum melompat ke teori konspirasi tentang pengadilan, Israel terutama menyalahkan dirinya sendiri," ia menulis dalam serangkaian posting dalam Ibrani pada X "Bahkan jika Anda tidak setuju dengan mayoritas pada setiap titik hukum, tidak ada negara yang masuk akal harus datang di mana saja dekat dengan jatuh pendek standar yang ditetapkan. Dalam banyak hal, pemerintah Netanyahu menggali lubang ini sendiri". ICJ pada hari Kamis menyimpulkan dalam keputusan 9- 6 bahwa pasukan keamanan Myanmar telah melakukan genosida terhadap populasi Rohingya di Negara Rakhine Utara selama operasi militer 2017. Penilaian, pertama kalinya pengadilan tertinggi PBB menyatakan bertanggung jawab atas genosida, menawarkan preseden hukum di Afrika Selatan dalam kasus ini menuduh Israel melakukan genosida melawan Palestina di Gaza, terutama atas bagaimana hakim menilai niat genosida ketika negara mengklaim tindakan militer didorong oleh tujuan keamanan. Untuk membuktikan genosida, ICJ pertama kali harus membuktikan bahwa tindakan genosida dilakukan, maka ada "maksud khusus" oleh negara bagian Myanmar untuk menghancurkan kelompok. Genosida niat niat Genosida jarang pernah dinyatakan secara eksplisit, sehingga pengadilan biasanya mengandalkan bukti tidak langsung. Dan di mana ada berbagai niat mungkin, seperti tujuan milit
articles.originalTitle: Israel likely to lose Gaza genocide case if ICJ follows Myanmar ruling, Tel Aviv scholar says
articles.originalDescription: Israel likely to lose Gaza genocide case if ICJ follows Myanmar ruling, Tel Aviv scholar says Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/23/2026 - 14:00 Israeli law professor Eliav Lieblich says language used by Myanmar officials mild compared to Netanyahu, Ben Gvir and others Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu looks on during a speech at the Israeli Knesset during the opening day of the new parliament in Jerusalem on 10 November 2026 (AFP) Off Israel will probably lose the genocide case brought by South Africa if the International Court of Justice (ICJ) applies the reasoning it used last week to find Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya, an Israeli international law scholar has said. “It is very bad that we have reached this point. It is a real earthquake,” said Eliav Lieblich, a professor at Tel Aviv University’s law faculty. “Before jumping to conspiracy theories about the court, Israel has mainly itself to blame,” he wrote in a series of posts in Hebrew on X. “Even if you disagree with the majority on every legal point, no reasonable country should come anywhere close to falling short of the standards it set. In many respects, Netanyahu’s government dug this hole itself.” The ICJ on Thursday concluded in a 9-6 decision that Myanmar's security forces had committed genocide against the Rohingya population in northern Rakhine State during the military's 2017 operations. The judgment, the first time the UN's highest court has found a state responsible for genocide, offers South Africa a significant legal precedent in its case accusing Israel of committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza, particularly over how judges assess genocidal intent when a state claims its military actions are driven by security objectives. To prove the genocide, the ICJ first had to prove that genocidal acts were committed, then that there was a “specific intent” by the Myanmar state to destroy the group. articles.title: Industri masalah pelayanan hampir 56.000 Sertifikat Asal pada bulan Oktober
articles.description: RIYADH - Departemen Industri dan Sumber Daya Mineral mengeluarkan 55.965 Khasiat Origin pada Oktober 2026. Ini adalah bagian dari upaya untuk mendukung dan memperlancar layanan bagi para pengekspor di seluruh industri, komersial, dan sektor individu. Menteri mengatakan dalam sebuah pernyataan bahwa Sertifikat Asal adalah sertifikat dokumen yang diekspor produk adalah asal nasional atau telah memperoleh status tersebut. Layanan menargetkan industri perusahaan, perusahaan komersial dan lembaga, serta individu, termasuk petani, nelayan, orang-orang terlibat dalam kegiatan individu, seniman lokal, dan lainnya. Departemen ini menjelaskan bahwa sertifikat tersedia dalam empat format: sebuah Sertifikat Origin untuk produk nasional yang ditakdirkan untuk Dewan Kerjasama Teluk (GCC); Sertifikat produk-produk nasional yang ditentukan untuk negara-negara Arab; sebuah Sertifikat Preferensial dari Origin, yang merupakan bentuk terpadu yang diadopsi oleh GCC untuk ekspor ke negara-negara dan blocs ekonomi dengan perjanjian perdagangan bebas telah diselesaikan; dan sebuah Bilingual (dan bahasa Inggris) yang diadopsi oleh negara-negara yang tidak memberikan pilihan umum. Ahli waris dapat menerapkan sertifikat Origin melalui situs kementerian.
articles.originalTitle: Industry ministry issues nearly 56,000 Certificates of Origin in October
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources issued 55,965 Certificates of Origin in October 2026. This was part of its efforts to support and streamline the service for exporters across the industrial, commercial, and individual sectors.The ministry said in a statement that a Certificate of Origin is a document certifying that exported products are of national origin or have acquired that status.The service targets industrial establishments, commercial companies and institutions, as well as individuals, including farmers, fishermen, people engaged in individual activities, local artisans, and others. The ministry explained that the certificate is available in four formats: a Certificate of Origin for national products destined for Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries; a Certificate of Origin for national products destined for Arab countries; a Preferential Certificate of Origin, which is the unified form adopted by the GCC for exports to countries and economic blocs with which free trade agreements have been concluded; and a bilingual (Arabic and English) Certificate of Origin for countries that do not grant preferential treatment (the general form).Beneficiaries can apply for a Certificate of Origin through the ministry's website.

articles.originalTitle: Israeli army suicides reach highest level since 2010: Press review
articles.originalDescription: Israeli army suicides reach highest level since 2010: Press review Submitted by Nadav Rapaport on Mon, 11/23/2026 - 14:10 Meanwhile, an army officer warns ‘Jewish terrorism’ in the West Bank could spread into Israel, and Kan 11 is urged to censor Gaza human shields investigation An Israeli army soldier looks at destroyed buildings in the Gaza Strip as troops stand on the boundary with the Palestinian territory, on 13 August 2025 (Jack Guez/AFP) Off Israeli military suicides reach 16-year high A total of 23 serving Israeli military personnel have died by suicide since the beginning of this year, the highest number recorded in the army since 2010, Haaretz reported on Monday. At least 17 former soldiers also died by suicide in the past year, shortly after being discharged from military service, bringing the total number of serving and former soldiers who took their own lives to 40. Suicides are not confined to Israel's military. Haaretz noted that five police officers also died by suicide in 2026. According to official Israeli military data cited by the report, 73 officers and soldiers have died by suicide since the Hamas-led attacks in southern Israel on 7 October. However, the actual number of war-related suicides is likely to be much higher, as the military's figures include only personnel who died while still serving. "This war is an unprecedented event in terms of the level of distress and burnout of the soldiers who took part in it," a mental health academic at the University of Haifa told Haaretz. "The coming years are critical, perhaps even dramatic, with regard to suicide rates." articles.description: Exclusive: Guatemala beredar proposal untuk mengekang kekuatan ICC sejalan dengan permintaan US- Israel Diberikan oleh Sondos Asem di Sat, 11 / 21 / 2026 - 18: 15 Negara Amerika Latin mengajukan gagasan ini kepada para diplomat di Den Haag meskipun ada pembelaan terhadap upaya untuk mengekang misi pengadilan Donald Trump berbicara sebagai Wapres JD Vance dan Sekretaris Negara Marco Rubio mendengarkan selama sebuah pengarahan berita di Gedung Putih pada 20 November 2026 (AFP) Guatemala telah mengedarkan proposal kepada negara-negara Internasional Crime Court (ICC) yang secara dekat dengan permintaan yang dibuat oleh Amerika Serikat dan Israel untuk membatasi kekuasaan pengadilan, Timur dapat mengungkapkan. Tiga halaman kertas telah disampaikan pada penutupan-pintu mundur untuk duta besar dari ICC anggota negara di Den Hague pada 18 November, kurang dari dua minggu sebelum pengadilan Majelis Amerika Parties (ASP) membuka sesi tahunan. Proposal ini menganjurkan dialog dengan AS lebih dari membatasi kemampuan ICC untuk mengejar kasus-kasus yang melibatkan negara-negara yang bukan anggota pengadilan, seperti AS, Israel dan Rusia. MEE memahami bahwa sekutu G7 Washington, termasuk Inggris, Jerman dan Italia, menyatakan kesiapan untuk mendiskusikan proposal serupa dengan AS tapi enggan untuk mendukung ide itu secara terbuka. Akibatnya, Guatemala, sebuah negara Amerika Latin bersekutu dengan Israel dan AS, memutuskan untuk memimpin dan menyusun proposal. Dokumen itu, dilihat oleh MEE, mencerminkan oposisi lama Washington terhadap penuntutan pemimpin Israel dan kemampuan pengadilan untuk juga menuntut pejabat AS atas kejahatan yang dilakukan di wilayah negara anggota. Kertas mengapung membutuhkan persetujuan dari negara tersangka kewarganegaraan bahkan ketika dugaan kejahatan berlangsung di wilayah negara anggota ICC. articles.originalTitle: Exclusive: Guatemala circulates proposal to curb ICC powers in line with US-Israeli demands
articles.originalDescription: Exclusive: Guatemala circulates proposal to curb ICC powers in line with US-Israeli demands Submitted by Sondos Asem on Sat, 11/21/2026 - 18:15 The Latin American country pitched the idea to diplomats in The Hague despite rights advocates warning against attempts to curb the court's mission Donald Trump speaks as Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio listen during a news briefing in the White House on 20 November 2026 (AFP) Off Guatemala has circulated a proposal to member states of the International Criminal Court (ICC) that closely echoed demands made by the United States and Israel to severely restrict the court's powers, Middle East Eye can reveal. The three-page paper was submitted at a closed-door retreat for ambassadors from ICC member states in The Hague on 18 November, less than two weeks before the court's Assembly of States Parties (ASP) opens its annual session. The proposal advocated for dialogue with the US over curbing the ICC's ability to pursue cases involving nationals of countries that aren't members of the court, such as the US, Israel and Russia. MEE understands that Washington's G7 allies, including the UK, Germany and Italy, expressed a readiness to discuss similar proposals with the US but were reluctant to advocate the idea publicly. As a result, Guatemala, a Latin American country allied with Israel and the US, decided to take the lead and draft the proposal. The document, seen by MEE, reflects Washington's longstanding opposition to the prosecution of Israeli leaders and the court's ability to also prosecute US officials for crimes committed on the territory of member states. The paper floats requiring consent from a suspect's country of nationality even when the alleged crimes took place on the territory of an ICC member state. articles.title: Lebih dari 45 juta transaksi elektronik pada bulan Oktober.
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Dalam Negeri elektronik Absher telah memproses total 45.168.522 transaksi elektronik untuk penerima selama Oktober. Melalui platform Absher Individuals, transaksi total mencapai 42.607.799, dan ini termasuk 33,989.242 dokumen dilihat melalui dompet dokumen digital, yang dapat diakses oleh warga, warga, dan pengunjung melalui aplikasi Absher. Sementara itu, platform bisnis Absher merekam 2.560,723 transaksi. Direktorat Umum Keamanan Umum diproses 3.539.011 transaksi, termasuk 3.400,356 oleh Direktorat Umum lalu lintas, 2.328.379 oleh General Directorat Passport, dan 450,714 oleh Departemen Dalam Negeri Status Badan Sipil. Melalui platform Absher Individuals, 108.073 laporan dikeluarkan menggunakan layanan Laporan Absher, sementara 2.100 pertanyaan umum terkait dengan sidik jari diproses. Perlu dicatat bahwa ID digital yang terpadu dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Dalam Negeri melalui platform Absher memungkinkan warga, penduduk, dan pengunjung untuk mengakses layanan yang disediakan oleh berbagai sektor pelayanan dengan mudah dan aman melalui platform elektronik: Individuals Absher, Businesses, dan Pemerintah Absher. Mereka juga memfasilitasi akses ke layanan yang ditawarkan oleh pemerintah dan swasta entitas melalui National Unified Access Portal Hafath.
articles.originalTitle: Absher carries out over 45 million electronic transactions in October
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Interior’s electronic platform Absher has processed a total of 45,168,522 electronic transactions for beneficiaries during October.Through the Absher Individuals platform, total transactions reached 42,607,799, and these include 33,989,242 document viewings through the digital document wallet, which is accessible to citizens, residents, and visitors via the Absher application. Meanwhile, the Absher Businesses platform recorded 2,560,723 transactions.The General Directorate of Public Security processed 3,539,011 transactions, including 3,400,356 by the General Directorate of Traffic, 2,328,379 by the General Directorate of Passports, and 450,714 by the Ministry of Interior’s Civil Status Agency. Through the Absher Individuals platform, 108,073 reports were issued using the Absher Reports service, while 2,100 general inquiries related to fingerprinting were processed.It is noteworthy that the unified digital IDs issued by the Ministry of Interior through the Absher platform enable citizens, residents, and visitors to access services provided by the ministry’s various sectors easily and securely through its electronic platforms: Absher Individuals, Absher Businesses, and Absher Government. They also facilitate access to services offered by government and private entities through the National Unified Access Portal Nafath.
